In addition, a competing model is used as a contrast for revealing the significant role of execution discrepancy. The competing model consists only of SEIS, decision time, and decision accuracy (see Fig. 3). Compared with the original model, the $R ^ { 2 }$ of decision time and decision accuracy in the competing model decrease substantially. Collectively, these analyses indicate that the construct of execution discrepancy does serve as a contributing mediating variable between self-efficacy and decision time and accuracy, and our operationalization of this construct contributes to future studies to delineate the theoretical effect between decision time and decision accuracy.

此外，还使用竞争模型作为对比，以揭示执行差异的重要作用。竞争模型仅包含 SEIS、决策时间和决策准确性（见图 3）。与原始模型相比，竞争模型的决策时间和决策精度$R^{2}$大幅下降。总的来说，这些分析表明，执行差异的结构确实是自我效能感与决策时间和准确性之间的中介变量，并且我们对该结构的操作化有助于未来的研究，以描述决策时间和决策准确性之间的理论影响。

## 5. Discussion and conclusion

## 5.讨论与结论

In this research, we have employed the eye-tracking technology to investigate the role of self-efficacy in attention engagement in decision strategy execution and how this attention engagement may influence the occurrence of action slips. We formulate the construct of execution discrepancy based on the eye-movement data and develop a regulatory model to examine its antecedents and consequences. This model show that the SEIS, self-efficacy in carrying out an intended strategy, exerts a significant influence on execution discrepancy, which, in turn, impacts decision performance in terms of both efficiency and accuracy. The re sults provide support for our proposition that SEIS may serve as an important motivational factor in modulating cognitive effort engage ment during strategy execution. Specifically, an individual with higher SEIS may appropriate a higher level of mental resource to avoid slips during the execution of planned EIPs, leading to better performance. Theoretically, our study demonstrates that it is possible to integrate the self-regulatory perspective and the multi-attribute decision-making framework that results in enhanced explanatory power. In addition, the application of the eye-tracking technology to compute the dissimilarity between the TEFS and the AEFS can provide a new methodological approach to the investigation of strategy execution behavior.

在本研究中，我们采用眼动追踪技术来研究自我效能感在决策策略执行中注意力投入中的作用，以及这种注意力投入如何影响行动失误的发生。我们根据眼球运动数据制定执行差异的结构，并开发一个监管模型来检查其前因和后果。该模型表明，SEIS（执行预期策略的自我效能）对执行差异产生重大影响，进而影响决策绩效的效率和准确性。结果支持了我们的主张，即 SEIS 可以作为调节战略执行过程中认知努力投入的重要激励因素。具体来说，SEIS 较高的个人可能会占用较高水平的心理资源，以避免在计划的 EIP 执行过程中出现失误，从而获得更好的绩效。理论上，我们的研究表明，将自律视角与多属性决策框架相结合是可能的，从而增强解释力。此外，应用眼动追踪技术计算TEFS和AEFS之间的差异可以为策略执行行为的研究提供新的方法论途径。

Our study demonstrates that the strategy execution behaviors may vary with different levels of self-regulation: the higher is the level of selfefficacy, the less likely that action slips may occur. This result contrib utes to the decision-making and DSS literature by examining the assumption that strategy can be correctly executed and by providing self-efficacy as a determinant to reduce action slips in terms of strategy execution. Previously, DSS studies have revealed that DSS might not promote people’s decision quality. Reasons to explain this failure include system design (insufficiency of system capabilities), contingency to the work environment (lack of fit to specific task types), and human factor (decision-makers’ tendency to save effort) [14,15]. Our action slip study adds self-efficacy as an additional explanatory factor. This implies that methods that can promote self-efficacy are likely to increase DSS performance. For example, the four general methods to promote efficacy can be used: mastery experience by providing adequate training, vicarious learning by providing seeded teachers, social persuasion by encouraging and motivating users, and even physiological factors by decreasing user fatigue. By using these methods, people could execute their intended strategy with a high level of accuracy and therefore in crease decision performance.

我们的研究表明，不同的自我调节水平，策略执行行为可能会有所不同：自我效能水平越高，发生行动失误的可能性就越小。这一结果通过检验战略能够正确执行的假设，并通过提供自我效能作为减少战略执行方面行动失误的决定因素，对决策和 DSS 文献做出了贡献。此前，DSS研究表明DSS可能不会提升人们的决策质量。造成这种失败的原因包括系统设计（系统能力不足）、工作环境的偶然性（不适合特定任务类型）和人为因素（决策者省力的倾向）[14,15]。我们的行动失误研究增加了自我效能感作为额外的解释因素。这意味着能够提高自我效能的方法可能会提高 DSS 绩效。例如，可以使用四种提高功效的一般方法：通过提供充分培训的掌握经验、通过提供种子教师的替代学习、通过鼓励和激励用户的社会说服，甚至通过减少用户疲劳的生理因素。通过使用这些方法，人们可以高度准确地执行他们的预期策略，从而提高决策绩效。

Our study also contributes to the IS usage and acceptance studies by showing that efficacy can strengthen the link between intention and usage. The study by Polites and Karahanna [10] has proposed that behavior intention might not translate to actual behavior during the introduction of a new IS because routines of old systems might inter vene. They further suggest that one useful method to reduce deviance between intention and actual behavior of IS usage is to provide training-in-context because training increases feelings of self-efficacy. Our study provides the evidence, in a decision-making context, to sup port their proposition by showing that self-efficacy can reduce the gap between usage intention and actual behavior.

我们的研究还表明功效可以加强意图和使用之间的联系，从而对信息系统的使用和接受研究做出了贡献。 Polites 和 Karahanna [10] 的研究提出，在引入新 IS 的过程中，行为意图可能不会转化为实际行为，因为旧系统的惯例可能会介入。他们进一步提出，减少信息系统使用意图与实际行为之间偏差的一种有用方法是提供情境培训，因为培训可以提高自我效能感。我们的研究在决策背景下提供了证据来支持他们的主张，表明自我效能可以缩小使用意图和实际行为之间的差距。

Our eye-tracking algorithm to measure strategy execution not only benefits future research but also can be incorporated into AI-based software agents and machines. Today, much research has been con ducted to build smarter and smarter machines. Yet, we are reminded of the old saying, “to err is human”. In fact, today’s age of smart machine is also seen by many experts as the age of human–machine (AI) collabo ration [92] and the need to lessen possible slips is even greater in the age of smart machine: as the intelligent and autonomous machines begin to alter how work is done in all manner of industries, the need fo human–machine collaboration has actually increased, not diminished, because there remain potentially destructive limitations of the tech nology. The eye-movement data offers a way to develop collaborative systems that are intelligent in both completing tasks and understanding human users. For example, autonomous vehicles that are equipped with the latest computer vision and deep learning technologies would still require data about the driver's cognitive state to attain effective human-machine collaboration. The eye-tracking technology, which en ables automatic collection of eye-movement data, can be important to design smart systems that are capable of detecting the driver’s state of attention and provide suitable assistance during critical moments. Our measurement of execution discrepancy could be implemented as a process monitoring function to remind the driver of the extent of strat egy execution discrepancy, and then providing them with appropriate guidance. In addition, our findings suggest that a possible intervention for enhancing the strategy execution can be developed by bolstering driver self-efficacy to handle critical situations.

我们用于衡量策略执行情况的眼动追踪算法不仅有利于未来的研究，而且还可以整合到基于人工智能的软件代理和机器中。如今，人们已经进行了大量研究来构建越来越智能的机器。然而，我们想起了那句老话：“人都会犯错”。事实上，当今的智能机器时代也被许多专家视为人机（AI）协作时代[92]，在智能机器时代，减少可能出现的失误的需求甚至更大：随着智能和自主机器开始改变各行各业的工作方式，人机协作的需求实际上增加了，而不是减少了，因为技术仍然存在潜在的破坏性限制。眼球运动数据提供了一种开发协作系统的方法，该系统在完成任务和理解人类用户方面都是智能的。例如，配备最新计算机视觉和深度学习技术的自动驾驶汽车仍然需要有关驾驶员认知状态的数据，以实现有效的人机协作。眼球追踪技术能够自动收集眼球运动数据，对于设计能够检测驾驶员注意力状态并在关键时刻提供适当帮助的智能系统非常重要。我们对执行差异的测量可以作为过程监控功能来实现，以提醒驾驶员策略执行差异的程度，然后为他们提供适当的指导。此外，我们的研究结果表明，可以通过增强驾驶员处理紧急情况的自我效能来制定增强策略执行的可能干预措施。

## 5.1. Limitation and future research

## 5.1.局限性和未来研究

One important limitation of our study is that the decision informa tion layout accords with the design of Payne’s classical experiment [29]. This design is much simpler than the real world purchasing environment and has the merit of excluding confounding factors. However, it is generally argued that the simplification reduces the external validity of the experiment. Future research can be conducted to evaluate the effect of designs that are more realistic and aesthetic, as those seen in Amazon. com. In addition, this study can provide guidance for the design of functionalities in designing IT-based interventions. For example, future research might develop a “self-efficacy inducing mechanism” into IT artifacts, and/or solution process monitoring functions based on our new measurement of execution discrepancy.

我们研究的一个重要局限性是决策信息布局符合佩恩经典实验的设计[29]。这种设计比现实世界的购买环境简单得多，并且具有排除混杂因素的优点。然而，人们普遍认为简化降低了实验的外部有效性。未来的研究可以评估更现实、更美观的设计效果，就像亚马逊上看到的那样。 com.此外，本研究还可以为设计基于信息技术的干预措施的功能设计提供指导。例如，未来的研究可能会在 IT 工件中开发一种“自我效能诱导机制”，和/或基于我们对执行差异的新测量的解决方案流程监控功能。

It is also important to note that our experiment includes only a stu dent sample. Although employing student samples has been common in the studies of self-efficacy and decision-making as well as in studies employing the eye-tracking technology in IS research (e.g., [14,43,60, 93]), the extent to which we can generalize from our student sample to the people in general remains unclear. Given that university students are young adults, caution should be exercised to generalize our results to ward other demographic groups such as elderly people or those who have less access of educational resources.

同样重要的是要注意，我们的实验仅包括学生样本。尽管在自我效能和决策研究以及信息系统研究中使用眼球追踪技术的研究中使用学生样本很常见（例如[14,43,60,93]），但我们可以在多大程度上从学生样本推广到一般人仍然不清楚。鉴于大学生是年轻人，应谨慎将我们的结果推广到其他人口群体，例如老年人或教育资源较少的人。

Finally, with regard to theoretical development, in this study we have established the novel construct of execution discrepancy and show that it effectively mediates between self-efficacy and performance. However, how execution discrepancy can interact with other variables that are related to self-efficacy remains untested and deserves future examinations. For example, it is likely that execution discrepancy is an immediate predictor of performance, and therefore, studies can be conducted to evaluate how competence-related factors such as task ef ficiency, risk management, time management, and expertise are medi ated by execution discrepancy to affect performance. Another direction of future study might integrate significant factors relating to the design of interventions with our proposed model in order to examine their combined influence on strategy execution behavior. For example, future researchers might jointly examine the effects of the motivational factor and EIP-automating aids on strategy execution, which was a significant idea proposed by Todd and Benbasat [15].

最后，在理论发展方面，在本研究中，我们建立了执行差异的新结构，并表明它可以有效地调节自我效能和绩效之间的关系。然而，执行差异如何与与自我效能相关的其他变量相互作用仍然未经测试，值得未来研究。例如，执行差异很可能是绩效的直接预测因素，因此，可以进行研究来评估与能力相关的因素（例如任务效率、风险管理、时间管理和专业知识）如何通过执行差异来调节以影响绩效。未来研究的另一个方向可能会将与干预设计相关的重要因素与我们提出的模型相结合，以检查它们对策略执行行为的综合影响。例如，未来的研究人员可能会联合研究激励因素和 EIP 自动化辅助对策略执行的影响，这是 Todd 和 Benbasat 提出的一个重要想法[15]。

# When will I get out of the Hospital? Modeling Length of Stay using Comorbidity Networks

# 我什么时候可以出院？使用合并症网络对住院时间进行建模

Pankush Kalgotra <sup>a</sup> and Ramesh Sharda<sup>b</sup>

Pankush Kalgotra <sup>a</sup> 和 Ramesh Sharda<sup>b</sup>

<sup>a</sup>Harbert College of Business, Auburn University Auburn, AL 36849 US; <sup>b</sup>Vice Dean, Watson Graduate School of Management, Regents Professor of Management Science and Information Systems, Spears School of Business, Oklahoma State University, OK 74078, USA

<sup>a</sup>奥本大学哈伯特商学院 Auburn, AL 36849 US； <sup>b</sup>沃森管理研究生院副院长、俄克拉荷马州立大学斯皮尔斯商学院管理科学与信息系统董事教授，OK 74078，美国

## ABSTRACT

## 抽象的

A reliable and accurate estimate of the expected hospital length of stay (LOS) of a patient is important to patients, medical providers, and insurance companies. Predicting hospital Length of Stay (LOS) is a complex and ill-structured problem, driven by many factors such as a patient’s individual characteristics, treatment plans, and disease-interactions. In this paper, we develop a novel model to predict the expected LOS at the time of admission by combining network science and deep learning. We propose a two-dimensional construct of latent comorbidities comprising historical and probable comorbidities that a patient does not currently manifest but could likely develop during the course of hospital stay. The probable comorbidities are derived from a network comprising relationships among diseases observed in 3.2 million patient records in hundreds of US hospitals. We employ this construct of latent comorbidities in deep learning models to predict patients’ LOS using almost 10 million other patient visits belonging to various disease categories. Implementing these models and analyses required a high-performance computing (Big Data) facility. The average mean absolute percent error of our models across all categories of diseases was 29.8%, which is the best in the current state-of-the-art. Our primary contribution is in developing a generalizable method to create a predictor construct for recognizing underlying relationships through network analyses, which can then be used in a deep learning model to predict an exogenous dependent variable.

可靠且准确地估计患者的预期住院时间 (LOS) 对于患者、医疗服务提供者和保险公司来说非常重要。预测住院时间 (LOS) 是一个复杂且结构不良的问题，受到患者个体特征、治疗计划和疾病相互作用等多种因素的影响。在本文中，我们结合网络科学和深度学习，开发了一种新颖的模型来预测入院时的预期 LOS。我们提出了潜在合并症的二维结构，包括患者当前未表现出来但可能在住院期间可能出现的历史和可能的合并症。可能的合并症源自一个网络，该网络包含在美国数百家医院的 320 万份患者记录中观察到的疾病之间的关系。我们在深度学习模型中采用这种潜在合并症的结构，通过属于不同疾病类别的近 1000 万其他患者就诊来预测患者的 LOS。实施这些模型和分析需要高性能计算（大数据）设施。我们的模型在所有疾病类别中的平均绝对百分比误差为 29.8%，这是当前最先进的水平。我们的主要贡献是开发一种可推广的方法来创建一个预测器构造，用于通过网络分析识别潜在关系，然后可以在深度学习模型中使用该预测器构造来预测外生因变量。

## KEYWORDS

## 关键词

health informatics; network analytics; deep learning; long short-term memory; comorbidity; comorbidity index; hospital length of stay; hospitalization prediction

健康信息学；网络分析；深度学习；长短期记忆；合并症；合并症指数；住院时间；住院预测

## Introduction

## 介绍

Prediction of hospital length of stay (LOS), like many other healthcare issues, is a wicked, complex, ill-structured, and dynamic problem. A problem may be defined as complex and ill-structured when its underlying state is unknown; it has multiple competing outcomes; it is afected by the interaction of several factors; and the environment under which it is tackled is dynamic and unpredictable, with time-delayed consequences for actions taken [26, 63, 86]. Predicting LOS at the time of admission is a complex problem because the underlying reasons for a hospital stay may not be clearly identified, and several patient-level, disease-level, hospital-level, treatment-level, and other factors (e.g. medical injuries during hospitalization) interact with each other in a dynamic environment. Of course, insurance companies are eager to determine ways in which a patient’s LOS can be shortened without adding to the risk of readmission. Hospitals themselves would like to know a patient’s expected LOS for optimal resource planning, among other reasons. Therefore, research on LOS prediction has been ongoing, and novel approaches are needed to improve this prediction. Given the importance of predicting LOS at the point of admission to diferent stakeholders such as patients, hospitals and insurance companies, and because previous attempts at predicting LOS sufer from low accuracy and limited applicability of proposed models across multiple diseases [53], our study attempts to create a deep learning predictive model for estimating the expected length of stay for all types of patients using the information available at the point of admission. We note that the objective of this paper is to create a predictive model to estimate the expected LOS but not build an optimization model to identify the right LOS. Deciding when to let a patient go home (which will clearly impact the LOS) to optimize a patient’s well-being and reduce likelihood of their readmission is a separate problem that has been studied by other researchers [68]. Our approach for measurement/prediction of the LOS could provide inputs into the prescriptive analytics problem of the right LOS. Given that hospital inpatient care constitutes nearly one-third (29%) of all healthcare expenses in the United States<sup>1</sup>, it is important to correctly estimate LOS early to manage workloads across departments as well as assist in a more accurate insurance precertification [68, 91].

与许多其他医疗保健问题一样，住院时间 (LOS) 的预测是一个棘手、复杂、结构不良且动态的问题。当问题的底层状态未知时，它可能被定义为复杂且结构不良的问题；它有多种相互竞争的结果；它受到多种因素相互作用的影响；解决该问题的环境是动态的、不可预测的，所采取的行动会产生滞后的后果[26,63,86]。入院时预测LOS是一个复杂的问题，因为住院的根本原因可能无法明确确定，并且多个患者级别、疾病级别、医院级别、治疗级别和其他因素（例如住院期间的医疗伤害）在动态环境中相互作用。当然，保险公司渴望确定如何在不增加患者再次入院风险的情况下缩短患者的 LOS。除其他原因外，医院本身也希望了解患者的预期 LOS，以实现最佳资源规划。因此，LOS预测的研究一直在进行，并且需要新的方法来改进这种预测。考虑到在入院时预测 LOS 对患者、医院和保险公司等不同利益相关者的重要性，并且由于之前预测 LOS 的尝试因准确性低且所提出的模型在多种疾病中的适用性有限而受到影响 [53]，我们的研究尝试创建一个深度学习预测模型，用于使用入院时可用的信息来估计所有类型患者的预期住院时间。我们注意到本文的目标是创建一个预测模型来估计预期的 LOS，而不是构建一个优化模型来识别正确的 LOS。决定何时让患者回家（这显然会影响 LOS）以优化患者的健康并降低其再次入院的可能性是其他研究人员研究过的一个单独问题 [68]。我们的 LOS 测量/预测方法可以为正确 LOS 的规范分析问题提供输入。鉴于医院住院护理占美国所有医疗保健费用的近三分之一 (29%)<sup>1</sup>，因此尽早正确估计 LOS 以管理跨部门的工作量并协助进行更准确的保险预认证非常重要 [68, 91]。

In this study, we use the concept of comorbidities to predict LOS. The presence of an additional disease in addition to the primary disease is known as a comorbidity [23]. Comorbidity has been considered as an important factor in predicting health outcomes (such as mortality, LOS, readmission, etc.) because two diseases jointly can have a diferent health outcome than the same two diseases occurring individually at diferent times. In other words, the concurrent presence of two diseases has an aggregated efect on the patient health, which may be diferent than the sum of the efects of two diseases, as discussed in the syndemic theory by Singer [87]. The eforts and strategies required to treat/cure multiple diseases simultaneously in a patient can be diferent from curing them independently, and thus can also impact the length of stay in a hospital [1, 5, 13].

在本研究中，我们使用合并症的概念来预测 LOS。除原发疾病外还存在其他疾病称为合并症[23]。合并症被认为是预测健康结果（例如死亡率、LOS、再入院等）的重要因素，因为两种疾病共同出现时可能会产生不同的健康结果，而同两种疾病在不同时间单独发生时可能会产生不同的健康结果。换句话说，两种疾病的同时存在对患者健康产生总体影响，这种影响可能不同于两种疾病影响的总和，正如 Singer 的综合症理论中所讨论的那样[87]。同时治疗/治愈患者多种疾病所需的努力和策略可能不同于单独治疗这些疾病，因此也会影响住院时间[1,5,13]。

When a patient visits a hospital, he/she comes with one or more primary complaints in addition to other known comorbidities, generally recorded on an admission note by the referring physician. The primary complaint and known comorbidities are observed at the time of admission. However, LOS might also be afected by some diseases that are not present at the time of admission or may manifest during the visit. In this study, we propose a concept of latent comorbidities to improve the LOS prediction. The comorbidities which are not present at the time of admission are defined as latent comorbidities. We conceptualize the construct latent comorbidities in two dimensions: historical comorbidities and probable comorbidities. The historical comorbidities are the diseases a patient had in the past (which may or may not be present during admission) whereas the probable comorbidities are the diseases a patient may develop during that specific hospital visit. Historical comorbidities can explain the past experience of a patient with diferent diseases, whereas the probable comorbidities can provide information on how a patient’s visit is likely to unfold. Thus, the latent comorbidities can provide information about the past and future states of a patient, and can be used to model factors that may help improve the prediction of

当患者去医院就诊时，除了其他已知的合并症之外，他/她还会出现一种或多种主要症状，这些症状通常由转诊医生记录在入院单上。在入院时观察主要主诉和已知的合并症。然而，LOS 也可能受到一些入院时不存在或就诊期间可能出现的疾病的影响。在本研究中，我们提出了潜在合并症的概念来改进 LOS 预测。入院时不存在的合并症被定义为潜在合并症。我们从两个维度概念化潜在的合并症：历史合并症和可能的合并症。历史合并症是患者过去患有的疾病（在入院期间可能存在也可能不存在），而可能合并症是患者在该特定医院就诊期间可能出现的疾病。历史合并症可以解释患有不同疾病的患者过去的经历，而可能的合并症可以提供有关患者就诊可能如何展开的信息。因此，潜在的合并症可以提供有关患者过去和未来状态的信息，并可用于对可能有助于改善预测的因素进行建模。

LOS at the time of admission. Our primary method novelty is in this idea of creating a multi-dimensional construct using historical and probable patterns., which can then be employed as a predictor construct in a deep learning model.

入院时的 LOS。我们的主要方法新颖之处在于使用历史和可能模式创建多维构造的想法，然后可以将其用作深度学习模型中的预测器构造。

The historical comorbidities are discernible from the medical records of a patient. However, to estimate the probable comorbidities, we adopt a network methodology to examine the complex interactions of diseases among each other. A network is a representation of interconnected parts, or nodes, of a system linked through well-defined connections or edges [64]. Barabási [4] and Rathkopf [75] have argued that the network method presents a powerful way to explain the interrelations of diseases. By applying the network methodology, we are able to model the disease interactions and characterize their impact on LOS. Specifically, we create a network of diseases, also known as a comorbidity network, comprising the relationships among diseases to compute the probable comorbidities. The connections of the observed diseases in the comorbidity network are used to identify probable comorbidities. This approach allows us to employ these historical and probable diseases to create a predictive model for estimating LOS at the time of admission. We adapt the network methodology in its ability to predict outcomes such as LOS, which are external to the network. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such use of a comorbidity network for predicting LOS. Our approach is novel because it incorporates the current information, past behavior and future possibilities.

从患者的病历中可以看出历史合并症。然而，为了估计可能的合并症，我们采用网络方法来检查疾病之间复杂的相互作用。网络是通过明确定义的连接或边缘链接的系统的互连部分或节点的表示[64]。 Barabási [4] 和 Rathkopf [75] 认为网络方法提供了解释疾病相互关系的有力方法。通过应用网络方法，我们能够对疾病相互作用进行建模并描述其对 LOS 的影响。具体来说，我们创建了一个疾病网络，也称为合并症网络，包含疾病之间的关系以计算可能的合并症。合并症网络中观察到的疾病的连接用于识别可能的合并症。这种方法使我们能够利用这些历史疾病和可能的疾病来创建一个预测模型，用于估计入院时的 LOS。我们调整网络方法，使其能够预测网络外部的结果，例如 LOS。据我们所知，这是首次使用共病网络来预测 LOS。我们的方法很新颖，因为它结合了当前信息、过去的行为和未来的可能性。

The concept of predicting probable comorbidities at the time of admission to predict LOS has multiple practical implications for the hospitals and insurance companies. At the arrival of a patient, the hospital has to get precertification for the payment from the insurance company based on a treatment plan for the current condition of the patient. If new complications arise after the admission, the treatment plan changes and the request for payment to the insurance company also changes. This afects the revenue management for the hospital and the insurance company. Also, through our method of predicting probable comorbidities at the time of admission, a better care plan may be followed by the providers using the insights on the current and probable diseases, which may include iatrogenic illnesses (that can be the results of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures undertaken on a patient [48]). Thus, it can firstly help minimize iatrogenic illnesses, and secondly, help inform efective revenue management strategies for the hospitals and insurance companies.

通过在入院时预测可能的合并症来预测 LOS，这一概念对医院和保险公司具有多重实际意义。患者到达后，医院必须根据患者当前状况的治疗计划获得保险公司的付款预先认证。如果入院后出现新的并发症，治疗方案会发生变化，向保险公司的付款要求也会发生变化。这影响了医院和保险公司的收入管理。此外，通过我们在入院时预测可能的合并症的方法，提供者可以利用对当前和可能的疾病的见解来遵循更好的护理计划，其中可能包括医源性疾病（可能是对患者进行诊断和治疗程序的结果[48]）。因此，它首先可以帮助最大限度地减少医源性疾病，其次可以帮助为医院和保险公司提供有效的收入管理策略。

To explain the approach, we present Figure 1 showing diferent types of comorbidities considered in the model. Consider a patient who visits the hospital with a complaint of diseases i.e. admission time comorbidities. We should note that a patient may report some symptoms, and initial diagnostics tests could lead to identification of these diseases, eventually leading to a decision/recommendation of admission for the patient. That is the time when an expected length of stay is ideally projected to receive precertification from an insurance provider as well as to plan for hospital resources. We identify the direct connections of admission time comorbidities, referred to as the probable comorbidities, from the comorbidity network. The diferent probable diseases could have a distinct impact on LOS, based on the diseases present at the time of admission. This dimension of latent comorbidities captures the risk for patients to develop specific diseases. In addition, it captures the seriousness and severity of the current health state of a patient. Let us assume that the said patient had some historical diseases in the past, historical comorbidities, which are retrieved from the patient’s medical history, although not necessarily reported by the patient during the current visit. Together, historical comorbidities and probable comorbidities make a two-dimensional construct of latent comorbidities.

为了解释该方法，我们展示图 1，显示模型中考虑的不同类型的合并症。考虑一位因疾病（即入院时合并症）而到医院就诊的患者。我们应该注意到，患者可能会报告一些症状，初步的诊断测试可能会导致这些疾病的识别，最终导致患者入院的决定/建议。这是理想的预期住院时间，以获得保险公司的预先认证以及规划医院资源的时间。我们从合并症网络中确定了入院时间合并症的直接联系，称为可能的合并症。根据入院时存在的疾病，不同的可能疾病可能对 LOS 产生不同的影响。潜在合并症的这一维度反映了患者患特定疾病的风险。此外，它还可以捕捉患者当前健康状况的严重性和严重程度。让我们假设该患者过去患有一些历史疾病、历史合并症，这些病史是从患者的病史中检索到的，尽管不一定是患者在当前就诊期间报告的。历史合并症和可能合并症共同构成了潜在合并症的二维结构。

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/aff79a57e93577ac69275fe0e95fab40e2a8d7e9a40ff2eda1dfd4f09ae49d68.jpg)
Figure 1. Diferent types of comorbidities

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/aff79a57e93577ac69275fe0e95fab40e2a8d7e9a40ff2eda1dfd4f09ae49d68.jpg)
图 1. 不同类型的合并症

Our objective is to employ disease-linkages inferred from historical records through network modeling and use these linkages for predictive analytics by two-step model building. In the first-step model, a network is inferred from the history of patients (an independent set of patients). In the second-step model, properties derived from the network models are used further for predictive analysis of an outcome (i.e. LOS), which is exogenous to the network. In other words, the predicted future diseases and historical comorbidities in addition to the known information are used for creating a predictive model for LOS. To build a predictive model, we adapt a long short-term memory (LSTM) deep learning model. LSTM is an artificial recurrent neural network (RNN) model, which can model multidimensional variables. LSTM-RNN is best suited for our approach because we have defined the construct of latent comorbidities in two dimensions: historical comorbidities and probable comorbidities.

我们的目标是通过网络建模利用从历史记录推断出的疾病联系，并通过两步模型构建使用这些联系进行预测分析。在第一步模型中，从患者的病史（一组独立的患者）推断出一个网络。在第二步模型中，从网络模型导出的属性进一步用于对网络外生的结果（即 LOS）进行预测分析。换句话说，除了已知信息之外，还使用预测的未来疾病和历史合并症来创建 LOS 预测模型。为了构建预测模型，我们采用了长短期记忆 (LSTM) 深度学习模型。 LSTM 是一种人工循环神经网络（RNN）模型，可以对多维变量进行建模。 LSTM-RNN 最适合我们的方法，因为我们已经从两个维度定义了潜在合并症的构造：历史合并症和可能合并症。

We emphasize here that we primarily focus on the predictions in this paper. Comorbidity has been used most often in previous research to explain the length of stay retrospectively by using the information of a full visit, as noted by Lu et al. [57] in a systematic review. It has rarely been used to predict LOS because the information about patient health at the admission point is limited. We note that the purpose of predictions is diferent from the explanations as elaborated by Shmueli [83]. The predictive modeling focuses on minimizing the diference between actual and predicted values whereas the explanatory modeling focusses on establishing a causal relationship between diferent factors. Our contributions in this paper corroborate with the roles of predictive analytics discussed by Shmueli and Koppius [84]: generating new model/theory, developing new measures, compare competing models, improving existing models, assessing relevance and assessing predictability.

我们在这里强调，我们主要关注本文的预测。正如 Lu 等人所指出的，在之前的研究中，合并症最常用于通过使用完整就诊的信息来回顾性地解释住院时间。 [57]系统综述。它很少被用来预测 LOS，因为有关患者入院时健康状况的信息有限。我们注意到预测的目的与 Shmueli [83] 所阐述的解释不同。预测模型的重点是最小化实际值和预测值之间的差异，而解释性模型的重点是建立不同因素之间的因果关系。我们在本文中的贡献证实了 Shmueli 和 Koppius [84] 讨论的预测分析的作用：生成新模型/理论、开发新措施、比较竞争模型、改进现有模型、评估相关性和评估可预测性。

To develop our comorbidity network and make predictions, we use the Cerner electronic medical record (EMR) data warehouse containing information on more than 24.7 million patients across 662 US hospitals over 16 years (2000-2015). Cerner provides a deidentified data warehouse to encourage health analytics research. One of the Cerner partners in this initiative is Oklahoma State University’s Center for Health Systems Innovation<sup>2</sup> The use of this massive dataset is one of the major strengths of our study. The large dataset allowed us to create models at diferent levels (network level and patient-visit level) using mutually exclusive datasets. Because of the large dataset, we were also able to develop separate comorbidity networks for men and women. Some previous studies have controlled for gender but rarely focused on and reported diferences in males and females explicitly, as noted by Short, Yang, and Jenkins [85]. It is important to study gender diferences because men and women might respond diferently to a disease in the presence of another disease as reported by Kalgotra, Sharda, and Crof [41]. Some thought leaders, such as Ovseiko, et al. [69] and Johnson, et al. [39], have argued for the recognition of gender diferences in health research, and we respond to their call in this study. Finally, the massive dataset allowed us to create models for patients with diferent classes of diseases. Due to the lack of availability of suficient data, past research largely studied the impact of just a few diseases or on a small set of patients. To the best of our knowledge, our study is the first to create LOS prediction models for almost all disease categories in one large efort.

为了开发我们的合并症网络并进行预测，我们使用了 Cerner 电子病历 (EMR) 数据仓库，其中包含 16 年来（2000-2015 年）美国 662 家医院超过 2470 万名患者的信息。 Cerner 提供去识别化数据仓库来鼓励健康分析研究。该计划的 Cerner 合作伙伴之一是俄克拉荷马州立大学卫生系统创新中心<sup>2</sup>。使用这一庞大数据集是我们研究的主要优势之一。大型数据集使我们能够使用互斥的数据集在不同级别（网络级别和患者就诊级别）创建模型。由于数据集庞大，我们还能够为男性和女性开发单独的合并症网络。正如 Short、Yang 和 Jenkins 所指出的，之前的一些研究已经控制了性别，但很少关注并明确报告男性和女性的差异[85]。研究性别差异很重要，因为正如 Kalgotra、Sharda 和 Crof 报道的那样，男性和女性在存在另一种疾病时可能会对另一种疾病产生不同的反应[41]。一些思想领袖，例如 Ovseiko 等人。 [69] 和约翰逊等人。 [39]，主张在健康研究中承认性别差异，我们在这项研究中回应了他们的呼吁。最后，庞大的数据集使我们能够为患有不同类别疾病的患者创建模型。由于缺乏足够的数据，过去的研究主要研究几种疾病或一小部分患者的影响。据我们所知，我们的研究首次为几乎所有疾病类别创建了 LOS 预测模型。

The network derived in our study is one of a class that emerges without the intentions of its nodes, often referred to as an unintentional or an implicit network [80, 99]. An implicit network emerges from a common underlying behavior of nodes such as comorbidities in a comorbidity network. This class difers from traditional or explicit networks, which are developed from the intentional actions of their members. The traditional networks such as online social network, world wide web, road network, power grid network and airport network are explicitly created. However, networks such as a co-citation network based on references in papers, a product-product network based on users purchases, a drug-drug network based on prescriptions, and a comorbidity network based on co-occurrences of diseases in patients are all implicit networks. Traditionally, network models have been used for link predictions, [56], and for studying the impact of the network on its nodes which are internal to the network [17]. In this paper, we take the application of an implicit network to the next level, exploring how it impacts the performance of an external variable, such as a patient’s LOS, which is not a part of the network itself. In other words, we study how the collective behavior of the nodes in an implicit network afects an exogenous outcome.

我们研究中派生的网络是在其节点没有意图的情况下出现的一类网络，通常被称为无意识或隐式网络 [80, 99]。隐式网络源自节点的共同底层行为，例如合并症网络中的合并症。这个类别不同于传统的或明确的网络，后者是根据其成员的有意行为发展起来的。明确创建了在线社交网络、万维网、路网、电网网、机场网等传统网络。然而，诸如基于论文引用的共被引网络、基于用户购买的产品-产品网络、基于处方的药物-药物网络、基于患者疾病共现的共病网络等网络都是隐式网络。传统上，网络模型已用于链路预测[56]，并用于研究网络对其内部节点的影响[17]。在本文中，我们将隐式网络的应用提升到了一个新的水平，探索它如何影响外部变量的性能，例如患者的 LOS，它不是网络本身的一部分。换句话说，我们研究隐式网络中节点的集体行为如何影响外生结果。

Our study contributes to the Information Systems literature by proposing to use an inferred network for predicting an exogenous outcome. Broadly, our contribution is in solving a problem using network methodology to predict future events (probable comorbidities) and then use them in conjunction with historical events (historical comorbidities) and current events (observed comorbidities) to predict an outcome (LOS), which is external to the network. The characteristics of the generalized problem space where this method is applicable are presented in Table 1. The table also includes the corresponding characteristics of our healthcare/LOS context. Our method can be applied to solve the problems where entities (customer, patient, etc.) implicitly perform some activities or events in a transaction, interactions of which (events or activities) can impact another related but diferent outcome for an entity (during diferent transactions). When only some minimum or incomplete information about the events by an entity is available (incomplete transaction), the interactions modeled through the network analysis can be used to predict the probable events in the first step. Then, when these probable events are coupled with the historical and known characteristics, the outcome of the incomplete transaction can be predicted more accurately. We also include a general flowchart of our method in Appendix A to illustrate how this approach can be applied to other problems.

我们的研究提出使用推断网络来预测外生结果，从而为信息系统文献做出了贡献。从广义上讲，我们的贡献是使用网络方法来解决问题，以预测未来事件（可能的合并症），然后将它们与历史事件（历史合并症）和当前事件（观察到的合并症）结合使用来预测网络外部的结果（LOS）。表 1 列出了适用该方法的广义问题空间的特征。该表还包括我们的医疗保健/LOS 环境的相应特征。我们的方法可以应用于解决实体（客户、患者等）在交易中隐式执行某些活动或事件的问题，其中的交互（事件或活动）可以影响实体的另一个相关但不同的结果（在不同的交易期间）。当只有关于实体事件的一些最小或不完整的信息可用时（不完整的交易），通过网络分析建模的交互可用于在第一步中预测可能的事件。然后，当这些可能事件与历史和已知特征相结合时，可以更准确地预测不完整交易的结果。我们还在附录 A 中提供了我们方法的一般流程图，以说明如何将该方法应用于其他问题。

In the past, implicit networks have been examined where the outcome of a node itself was predicted. For example, Dhar et al. [17] analyzed a co-purchase network of books and predicted a book’s demand. Our model is diferent because we are making the prediction of an outcome of the source using the inferred network. This is analogous to predicting an attribute/outcome for the customers who bought various books, which leads to the book network in Dhar et al. study [17]. For example, could the book network be used to model/ predict the lifetime value of a customer, credit risk, or political afiliation of a customer at a granular level using her current purchases, historical purchases, and likely purchases (by employing the book network)? Our approach can also be applied to study similar problems in other domains. For instance, could an inferred network of web pages be used to predict the credit score of a user using the information about his landing page in a browsing session? Similarly, it may be used to estimate purchasing power of a tourist staying in a hotel by employing a network of activities performed by tourists. Recently, psychologists and psychiatrists have begun to explore use of Big Data and deep learning models for predicting human behavior. See for example, a recent special issue in a Nature afiliated journal [76]. We submit that an inferred network-based approach will be an even more powerful method in those problems where interrelationships from the past can impact future activities/ events/characteristics in unique ways, all of which can then become predictor variable in a diferent problem.

过去，人们对隐式网络进行了检查，其中预测了节点本身的结果。例如，达尔等人。 [17]分析了图书的共同购买网络并预测了图书的需求。我们的模型有所不同，因为我们正在使用推断网络对源的结果进行预测。这类似于预测购买各种书籍的顾客的属性/结果，这导致了 Dhar 等人的图书网络。研究[17]。例如，图书网络是否可以用于使用客户当前购买、历史购买和可能购买（通过使用图书网络）在粒度级别上建模/预测客户的终生价值、信用风险或政治派别？我们的方法也可以应用于研究其他领域的类似问题。例如，可以使用推断的网页网络来使用有关用户在浏览会话中的登陆页面的信息来预测用户的信用评分吗？类似地，它可以用于通过采用游客执行的活动网络来估计住在酒店的游客的购买力。最近，心理学家和精神病学家开始探索使用大数据和深度学习模型来预测人类行为。例如，参见 Nature 附属期刊最近的一期特刊 [76]。我们认为，在过去的相互关系可以以独特的方式影响未来的活动/事件/特征的问题中，基于网络的推断方法将是一种更强大的方法，所有这些都可以成为不同问题中的预测变量。

Our approach presents an integration of implicit network methodology and a deep learning model. By developing this combination, we contribute to the analytics literature. Shmueli and Koppius [84] argued in their commentary that a construct and a method development using analytics is a theory contribution. In addition, we add to the existing knowledge by building predictive models using our network approach that outperform the extant models. Creating a better model than the existing models that provides business value [2, 29] is another contribution of analytics as discussed by Shmueli and Koppius [84]. The proposed network-based models coupled with deep learning can improve decisionmaking outcomes and can be embedded in LOS estimation modules.

我们的方法提出了隐式网络方法和深度学习模型的集成。通过开发这种组合，我们为分析文献做出了贡献。 Shmueli 和 Koppius [84] 在他们的评论中认为，使用分析的构建和方法开发是一种理论贡献。此外，我们还通过使用优于现有模型的网络方法构建预测模型来补充现有知识。正如 Shmueli 和 Koppius [84] 所讨论的，创建比现有模型更好的模型来提供商业价值 [2, 29] 是分析的另一个贡献。所提出的基于网络的模型与深度学习相结合可以改善决策结果，并且可以嵌入到LOS估计模块中。

In section 2, we review related works on LOS, comorbidities, and identify the research gaps. In section 3, we describe our models, and include a demonstration of comorbidity network building. In section 4, we discuss our data processing and analysis, and address issues related to Electronic Medical Record (EMR). In section 5, we present the predictive power of the models proposed, followed by the implications of our results in the final section.

在第 2 节中，我们回顾了 LOS、合并症的相关工作，并确定了研究差距。在第 3 节中，我们描述了我们的模型，并包括共病网络构建的演示。在第 4 节中，我们讨论数据处理和分析，并解决与电子病历 (EMR) 相关的问题。在第 5 节中，我们介绍了所提出模型的预测能力，然后在最后一节中介绍了我们的结果的含义。

## Literature Review

## 文献综述

## Prediction of Length of Stay

## 停留时间的预测

The problem of predicting LOS has been studied for many years. A list and review of related studies may be found in Table 2, which includes the performance of extant models, and whether the models were applicable at the point of admission. A majority of the previous studies considered just one or a few classes of diseases in patients or focused on particular events such as heart surgery, knee operation, etc. This is due to the limited availability of data and mostly a focus to explain how LOS is related to a specific class of diseases. The models developed using such few types of patients cannot be generalized to other diseases. In our study, we develop models for a broad group of patients admitted due to many disease categories.

预测LOS的问题已经被研究了很多年。相关研究的列表和回顾可以在表2中找到，其中包括现有模型的性能，以及这些模型在入院时是否适用。以往的研究大多数只考虑患者的一类或几类疾病，或者关注特定事件，如心脏手术、膝关节手术等。这是由于数据有限，而且主要侧重于解释 LOS 与特定类别疾病的关系。使用如此少数类型的患者开发的模型不能推广到其他疾病。在我们的研究中，我们为因多种疾病类别而入院的广泛患者群体开发了模型。

In addition, the majority of past studies utilized data from an entire hospital visit including lab tests, other known comorbidities emerging from lab reports, procedures, etc. retrospectively. Such analyses are common to better explain and understand the scenarios, but obviously those models are not applicable for prediction. In fact, the extant scales for comorbidity such as Charlson index, [9] also require data from a full visit. In such studies, the primary purpose is not to predict LOS but to understand and identify important factors afecting LOS. However, our network approach uses only admission level information to predict LOS.

此外，过去的大多数研究都利用了整个医院就诊的数据，包括实验室检查、实验室报告、手术等中出现的其他已知合并症。此类分析很常见，可以更好地解释和理解场景，但显然这些模型不适用于预测。事实上，现有的合并症量表，例如查尔森指数，[9] 也需要来自完整访问的数据。在此类研究中，主要目的不是预测 LOS，而是了解和识别影响 LOS 的重要因素。然而，我们的网络方法仅使用准入级别信息来预测 LOS。

A few previous studies have used a classification approach to categorize a hospital visit into a class (long, medium, short stay, etc.) such as Carter and Potts [8] and Hachesu et al. [31]. While somewhat useful, this prediction is less useful than a more precise estimate of the LOS. Likewise, there are a few studies on LOS that reported performance with a

## Length of Stay and Comorbidity

## 住院时间和合并症

Comorbidity has been shown to be related to LOS in the past, as the presence of two or more conditions requires more care and resources to cure jointly. In the literature, there is no consensus on the definition of comorbidity. The concept has been theorized using four distinctions by Valderas et al. [94]. The first is based on the nature of the health conditions occurring concurrently. The second is based on the relative importance of the co-occurring conditions where one disease is given more importance than the others, and the presence of another condition is considered a comorbidity. The third distinction is based on the chronology of development of the conditions considering that one disease can lead to another. The fourth distinction considers illness burden and patients’ socioeconomic conditions that can play a role in the presence of multiple diseases. In these four distinctions, Valderas et al. considered patients’ clinical and socioeconomic factors to conceptualize comorbidity [94]. Jakovljevic and Ostojic [37] alternatively defined comorbidity in three diferent ways based on only diseases diagnosed in patients: first, when two diseases are present simultaneously but independently; second, when one disease causes another, making them interdependent; third, when multiple diseases are present regardless of their causal relationships. We adapt this third definition by Jakovljevic and Ostojic, and define comorbidity as the presence of multiple diseases simultaneously during a hospital visit [37].

过去，合并症已被证明与 LOS 相关，因为两种或多种疾病的存在需要更多的护理和资源来共同治疗。在文献中，对于合并症的定义尚未达成共识。 Valderas 等人利用四个区别对这一概念进行了理论化。 [94]。第一个是基于同时发生的健康状况的性质。第二种是基于同时发生的疾病的相对重要性，其中一种疾病比其他疾病更重要，并且另一种疾病的存在被认为是合并症。第三个区别是基于疾病发展的时间顺序，考虑到一种疾病可以导致另一种疾病。第四个区别考虑了疾病负担和患者的社会经济条件，这些条件可能在多种疾病的存在中发挥作用。在这四个区别中，Valderas 等人。考虑患者的临床和社会经济因素来概念化合并症[94]。 Jakovljevic 和 Ostojic [37] 仅根据患者诊断的疾病以三种不同的方式定义了合并症：首先，两种疾病同时但独立存在；其次，当一种疾病引起另一种疾病时，使它们相互依赖；第三，当多种疾病同时存在时，无论其因果关系如何。我们采用了 Jakovljevic 和 Ostojic 的第三个定义，并将合并症定义为在医院就诊期间同时存在多种疾病 [37]。

Many scales have been proposed to measure comorbidity. For example, de Groot et al. identified twelve diferent indexes, concluding that the Charlson Index, the Cumulative Illness Rating Scale (CISR), the Index of co-Existent Disease (ICED), and the Kaplan Index are reliable and can be used in clinical research [16]. Since CISR, ICED, and Kaplan require clinical judgment and information, we consider the Charlson Index in our model because it is possible to compute it based on medical records. Originally created for predicting mortality, the Charlson Index assigns weights to 19 diferent medical conditions. Some studies have found it to be related to LOS. For instance, Librero, Peiró, and Ordiñana conducted a simple bivariate analysis, finding that LOS increases with the Charlson Index score [52]. Rochon et al. also found a significant relationship between LOS and comorbidity indexes, however with low efect $( \mathrm { R } ^ { 2 } = 0 . 0 6 )$ [78].

已经提出了许多量表来衡量合并症。例如，德格鲁特等人。确定了十二个不同的指数，得出的结论是查尔森指数、累积疾病评定量表（CISR）、共存疾病指数（ICED）和卡普兰指数是可靠的，可以用于临床研究[16]。由于 CISR、ICED 和 Kaplan 需要临床判断和信息，因此我们在模型中考虑查尔森指数，因为可以根据医疗记录进行计算。查尔森指数最初是为了预测死亡率而创建的，它为 19 种不同的医疗状况分配权重。一些研究发现它与LOS有关。例如，Librero、Peiró 和 Ordiñana 进行了简单的双变量分析，发现 LOS 随着 Charlson 指数得分的增加而增加 [52]。罗雄等人。还发现 LOS 和合并症指数之间存在显着关系，但效果较低 $( \mathrm { R } ^ { 2 } = 0 . 0 6 )$ [78]。

Past studies have rarely used such comorbidity scales for LOS prediction purposes because information about an entire visit is needed to know all of a patient’s diseases (Table 2 lists some of those studies). If information about comorbidities at the point of admission is not available, it cannot be used to make predictive models for LOS. Therefore, a mechanism is required to first predict comorbidities and then use it for LOS predictions. Most previous studies have focused on one disease at a time. For instance, Hachesu et al. [31] studied comorbidities of coronary artery disease, Yang et al. [96] considered sepsis patients, Lowell and Davis [55] included schizophrenia and afective disorder, Thombs, et al. [92] examined burn injury, and Lyketsos, et al. [58], Furlanetto and da Silva [27], Stecker et al. [90], and Huntley, et al. [36] analyzed psychiatric-related comorbidities. Therefore, the previous models are applicable to only specific categories of patients and lack generalizability across disease categories.

过去的研究很少使用此类合并症量表来预测 LOS，因为需要有关整个就诊的信息才能了解患者的所有疾病（表 2 列出了其中一些研究）。如果无法获得入院时的合并症信息，则无法使用该信息建立 LOS 预测模型。因此，需要一种机制来首先预测合并症，然后将其用于 LOS 预测。以前的大多数研究一次只关注一种疾病。例如，Hachesu 等人。 Yang等人[31]研究了冠状动脉疾病的合并症。 Lowell 和 Davis [96] 认为败血症患者 [55] 包括精神分裂症和情感障碍，Thombs 等人。 [92] 检查了烧伤，Lyketsos 等人。 [58]，Furlanetto 和 da Silva [27]，Stcker 等人。 [90]和亨特利等人。 [36]分析了精神科相关的合并症。因此，以前的模型仅适用于特定类别的患者，缺乏跨疾病类别的普遍性。

Our literature review identifies three research gaps in this specific problem. First, as noted just above, most past studies restricted their analyses to a few categories of diseases, and thus their models are only applicable to the specific types of patients. Second, the existing comorbidity scales such as Charlson Index consider only a subset of diseases. Our network approach measures all disease relationships from a database encompassing millions of patients in the United States. Finally, to the best of our knowledge, no one has applied an implicit network approach and used its properties to predict LOS. Our study attempts to fill all these research gaps.

我们的文献综述确定了这个特定问题的三个研究空白。首先，如上所述，过去的大多数研究将其分析仅限于几类疾病，因此他们的模型仅适用于特定类型的患者。其次，现有的合并症量表（例如查尔森指数）仅考虑疾病的一个子集。我们的网络方法从包含美国数百万患者的数据库中测量所有疾病关系。最后，据我们所知，没有人应用隐式网络方法并利用其特性来预测 LOS。我们的研究试图填补所有这些研究空白。

## Latent Comorbidities Construct Development

## 潜在的合并症构建发展

We begin by explaining the notations used for our construct development followed, by a description of the method for creating latent comorbidities. Let the universal set of n diseases be denoted by $D = \{ 1 , 2 , \dots n \}$ . A patient during a hospital visit, V, presents him/ herself with a set of known diseases, k, where $k \subseteq D .$ . The set k is measured as the observed comorbidities as these are the only diseases known at the time of admission. However, the set k does not contain all diseases of that full visit as some diseases may be diagnosed later during the same visit. We denote the set of all diseases during the full visit by v where $\nu \subseteq D$ and $k \subseteq \nu .$ In addition, before the visit V, the patient might have a set of past diseases measured as historical comorbidities, h $( \subseteq D )$ . So, there are three diferent sets: known diseases at the time of an admission (k), all diseases during a visit (v), and historical diseases (h). Based on the known diseases, k, we develop a method to predict the risk of additional comorbidities (probable) using a comorbidity network as described below.

我们首先解释用于构建开发的符号，然后描述创建潜在合并症的方法。让 n 种疾病的通用集合表示为 $D = \{ 1 , 2 , \dots n \}$ 。患者在医院就诊期间 V 向自己展示了一组已知疾病 k，其中 $k \subseteq D .$ 。集合 k 被测量为观察到的合并症，因为这些是入院时唯一已知的疾病。然而，集合 k 并不包含该完整就诊的所有疾病，因为某些疾病可能会在同一次就诊期间稍后被诊断出来。我们用 v 表示完整访视期间所有疾病的集合，其中 $\nu \subseteq D$ 和 $k \subseteq \nu 。$ 此外，在访视 V 之前，患者可能有一组作为历史合并症衡量的过去疾病，h $( \subseteq D )$ 。因此，存在三个不同的集合：入院时的已知疾病 (k)、就诊期间的所有疾病 (v) 和历史疾病 (h)。根据已知疾病 k，我们开发了一种方法，使用如下所述的合并症网络来预测其他合并症（可能的）风险。

## Comorbidity Network

## 合并症网络

In our comorbidity network, diseases that are likely to co-occur during a hospital visit are connected to one other. Since the focus is on relationships based on co-occurrences during the same visit and the time diference between diagnosis of two diseases may be too small to derive the direction or sequence of diagnosis of diseases during the same visit, we created edges between diseases with no direction. For example, an edge between congestive heart failure and rheumatic heart disease represents an undirected connection between two nodes representing these two diseases. This is a parsimonious approach where we do not make an assumption of directionality, which makes our method applicable to the patients even where directionality of the diseases is unknown. This parsimonious approach leads to models that are more broadly applicable. A model incorporating the timing of the diseases (directionality) could potentially be even more accurate, but such information in practice may be unavailable, leading to even fewer datapoints for machine learning. Our models performance improvements without knowing the directionality is a strength of the approach. Our network is implicit, and links between diseases are inferred considering the set of diseases during a hospital visit from an analysis of the millions of observed patient encounters in a hospital, $\nu = \{ 1 , 2 , 3 , \ldots t \}$ where t≤n.

在我们的合并症网络中，在医院就诊期间可能同时发生的疾病彼此相关。由于重点是基于同一次就诊期间同时发生的关系，并且两种疾病的诊断之间的时间差可能太小而无法得出同一就诊期间疾病诊断的方向或顺序，因此我们在没有方向的疾病之间创建了边缘。例如，充血性心力衰竭和风湿性心脏病之间的边代表代表这两种疾病的两个节点之间的无向连接。这是一种简约的方法，我们不做出方向性假设，这使得我们的方法即使在疾病方向性未知的情况下也适用于患者。这种简约的方法可以产生更广泛适用的模型。包含疾病发生时间（方向性）的模型可能会更加准确，但实践中可能无法获得此类信息，从而导致机器学习的数据点更少。我们的模型性能在不知道方向性的情况下得到改进是该方法的优点。我们的网络是隐式的，通过对医院内数百万观察到的患者遭遇的分析，考虑到医院就诊期间的疾病集，推断疾病之间的联系，$\nu = \{ 1 , 2 , 3 , \ldots t \}$ 其中 t≤n 。

We denote $C = ( D , E )$ as a loop-less, undirected, and weighted comorbidity network, where $D = \{ 1 , 2 , \dots n \}$ is the node set of C, and $E \subseteq D \mathrm { X } D$ is the edge set of C. The edges in a comorbidity network are derived from the x number of hospital visits across the patients. The symmetric n x n matrix $A _ { C } = \left( a _ { i j } \right) _ { \left( i j \right) \in { \cal D } \mathrm {  ~ X ~ } { \cal D } } ,$ where $a _ { i j } > 0 \mathrm { i f } ( i , j ) \in E$ is an edge of C and $a _ { i j } = 0 { \mathrm { ~ i f ~ } } ( i , j ) \notin E ,$ , is called the adjacency matrix of C.

我们将 $C = ( D , E )$ 表示为无环、无向、加权共病网络，其中 $D = \{ 1 , 2 , \dots n \}$ 是 C 的节点集，$E \subseteq D \mathrm { X } D$ 是 C 的边集。共病网络中的边源自患者的 x 次医院就诊次数。对称 n x n 矩阵 $A _ { C } = \left( a _ { i j } \right) _ { \left( i j \right) \in { \cal D } \mathrm { ~ X ~ } { \cal D } } ,$ 其中 $a _ { i j } > 0 \mathrm { i f } ( i , j ) \in E$ 是 C 的一条边，$a _ { i j } = 0 { \mathrm { ~ if ~ } } ( i , j ) \notin E ,$ 称为 C 的邻接矩阵。

In the past, the strength of an edge between diseases or comorbidities $( a _ { i j } )$ has been modeled using a simple Pearson’s correlation coeficient [19, 34]. However, several researchers such as Ahlgren et. al [3] and Kalgotra et al. [43] have criticized the use of correlation for modeling co-occurrences and have recommended Salton Cosine Index (SCI) [81]. SCI is defined as the inner product of two vectors divided by the product of their lengths. For binary vectors, the cosine measure is also called the Ochiai coeficient [7, 66–67, 98]. In this study, we adopt Ochiai coeficient to quantify the relationship between two diseases as the co-occurrences are denoted by binary vectors. Ochiai coeficient, $a _ { i j } ,$ of two diseases i and j is calculated as in equation 1, where $c _ { i j }$ is the number of hospital visits with i and j together, $c _ { i }$ is the number of hospital visits having i disease, and $c _ { j }$ is the number of hospital visits having j disease. Here, $c _ { i j } \leq \left( c _ { i } c _ { j } \right)$ and $( c _ { i j } , \ c _ { i } , c _ { j } ) \leq x .$ : The Ochiai cosine similarity has been used in the past to find phenotype overlaps [12, 49–51], and we propose this as an appropriate measure for calculating the strength of a comorbidity.

过去，疾病或合并症 $( a _ { i j } )$ 之间的边缘强度是使用简单的皮尔逊相关系数建模的 [19, 34]。然而，一些研究人员，如 Ahlgren 等人。 al [3] 和 Kalgotra 等人。 [43]批评了使用相关性来建模共现，并推荐了索尔顿余弦指数（SCI）[81]。 SCI 定义为两个向量的内积除以它们长度的乘积。对于二元向量，余弦测度也称为 Ochiai 系数 [7, 66–67, 98]。在本研究中，我们采用 Ochiai 系数来量化两种疾病之间的关系，因为同时发生的疾病由二元向量表示。两种疾病 i 和 j 的 Ochiai 系数 $a _ { i j } ,$ 的计算方法如公式 1 所示，其中 $c _ { i j }$ 是 i 和 j 一起就诊的医院次数，$c _ { i }$ 是患有 i 疾病的医院就诊次数，$c _ { j }$ 是患有 j 疾病的医院就诊次数。这里， $c _ { i j } \leq \left( c _ { i } c _ { j } \right)$ 和 $( c _ { i j } , \ c _ { i } , c _ { j } ) \leq x .$ ：Ochiai 余弦相似度过去曾被用来寻找表型重叠 [12, 49–51]，我们建议将其作为一个合适的模型。计算合并症强度的措施。

$$
a _ {i j} = \frac {\left(c _ {i j}\right)}{\sqrt {\left(c _ {i} * c _ {j}\right)}}\tag{1}
$$

The n x n comorbidity adjacency matrix $A _ { C }$ contains $a _ { i j }$ of all pairs of diseases as shown in Equation 2. Since the network is symmetric and loop-less, $a _ { i j } = a _ { j i }$ , and $a _ { i j } = 0$ where i=j. This matrix is a transition matrix containing Ochiai index, which is used to identify and quantify latent comorbidities for a patient at the point of admission as described below.

n x n 共病邻接矩阵 $A _ { C }$ 包含所有疾病对的 $a _ { i j }$，如公式 2 所示。由于网络是对称且无环的，因此 $a _ { i j } = a _ { j i }$ 和 $a _ { i j } = 0$，其中 i=j。该矩阵是包含 Ochiai 指数的转换矩阵，用于识别和量化患者入院时的潜在合并症，如下所述。

$$
\left[ \begin{array}{c c c c} 0 & a _ {1 2} & \ldots & a _ {1 n} \\ a _ {2 1} & 0 & \ldots & \vdots \\ \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ a _ {n 1} & \ldots & & 0 \end{array} \right]\tag{2}
$$

## Latent Comorbidities

## 潜在的合并症

We infer probable comorbidities from the network defined in the previous section based on the set of known diseases, k, at the time of admission. Equation 3 shows the computation of probable diseases denoted by COM. It is calculated by multiplying the binary array of the list of known diseases, Pres $= ( k _ { I } , k _ { 2 } , k _ { 3 } \dots k _ { n } )$ , with the adjacency matrix $A _ { C } .$ In the adjacency matrix, theoretically, a disease can be connected to n-1 other diseases. Therefore, to keep the predictions at a manageable level and select the number of connections of a disease, we compared the median and mean of the distribution of the count of diseases across hospital visits. The distribution of the count of diseases was right skewed with a mean of 5.01 and a median of 4. To include more information in the model, we selected the higher number and consider the top five connections of a disease. The resulting array contains the connections and strengths of direct links of the known disease denoted by $\left( p _ { I } , p _ { 2 } , p _ { 3 } \ldots p _ { n } \right)$ . Our construct of latent comorbidities is a combination of historical and probable comorbidities. We create a two-dimensional construct with historical comorbidities as one dimension and probable comorbidities as the second dimension. The binary array of historical diseases, $h i s = ( h _ { I } , h _ { 2 } ,$ $h _ { 3 } \ldots h _ { n } )$ is concatenated with COM and reshaped to two dimensions in the shape of 2Xn as presented in Equation $^ { 4 , }$ denoted by uCOM. From the formulation, this measurement involves a sequence describing presence of a disease i in history $\left( { { h } _ { i } } \right)$ and likelihood of it being in future $\left( { p _ { i } } \right)$ . An algorithm to create uCOM construct for a hospital visit is added in Appendix B.

我们根据入院时已知疾病 k 的集合，从上一节定义的网络中推断出可能的合并症。公式 3 显示了用 COM 表示的可能疾病的计算。它是通过已知疾病列表的二进制数组 Pres $= ( k _ { I } , k _ { 2 } , k _ { 3 } \dots k _ { n } )$ 与邻接矩阵 $A _ { C } .$ 相乘计算得出。在邻接矩阵中，理论上，一种疾病可以与 n-1 个其他疾病连接。因此，为了将预测保持在可管理的水平并选择疾病的联系数量，我们比较了各医院就诊的疾病计数分布的中位数和平均值。疾病计数的分布呈右偏态，平均值为 5.01，中位数为 4。为了在模型中包含更多信息，我们选择了较高的数字并考虑了与疾病的前 5 个关联。结果数组包含已知疾病的直接联系的联系和强度，用 $\left( p _ { I } , p _ { 2 } , p _ { 3 } \ldots p _ { n } \right)$ 表示。我们对潜在合并症的构建是历史合并症和可能合并症的组合。我们创建一个二维结构，其中历史合并症作为一个维度，可能的合并症作为第二个维度。历史疾病的二进制数组 $h i s = ( h _ { I } , h _ { 2 } ,$ $h _ { 3 } \ldots h _ { n } )$ 与 COM 连接并重塑为 2Xn 形状的二维，如方程 $^ { 4 , }$ 所示，用 uCOM 表示。从公式来看，该测量涉及描述疾病 i 在历史 $\left( { { h } _ { i } } \right)$ 中的存在以及它在未来 $\left( { p _ { i } } \right)$ 中的可能性的序列。附录 B 中添加了为医院就诊创建 uCOM 构造的算法。

$$
C O M = P r e s ^ {*} A _ {C}
$$

$$
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c c} k _ {1} & k _ {2} & \ldots & k _ {n} \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c c} 0 & a _ {1 2} & \ldots & a _ {1 n} \\ a _ {2 1} & 0 & \ldots & \vdots \\ \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ a _ {n 1} & \ldots & & 0 \end{array} \right]
$$

$$
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c c} p _ {1} & p _ {2} & \dots & p _ {n} \end{array} \right]\tag{3}
$$

$$
u C O M = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c c c} h _ {1} & h _ {2} & h _ {3} \ldots & h _ {n - 1} & h _ {n} \\ p _ {1} & p _ {2} & p _ {3} \ldots & p _ {n - 1} & p _ {n} \end{array} \right]\tag{4}
$$

## Modeling

## 建模

To create the predictive models, we first identify the predictor variables from the previous research as discussed in literature review. The variables from past research used in our LOS models include: demographics variables such as age, gender, marital status and race; visit information such as the patient type (inpatient or emergency), admission type (emergency, urgent, elective, new born, trauma center, etc.), admission source (physician referral, emergency room, clinic referral, transfer from another health care facility, transfer from a hospital, born inside this hospital, normal delivery, etc.); hospital information such as the size (measured by number of beds), acute status, teaching facility, census region, and urbanrural status. In addition, there is some evidence that insurance type also afects LOS, with Medicaid insurance holders having longer stays than others [54, 59]. Therefore, we consider the insurance type as well. Besides, Huntley et al. [36] showed that LOS was afected by the number of previous admissions indicating the critical condition of a patient. Therefore, we create a variable as a counter measuring the visit number for the patient. In addition, the readmission days (time interval between current and last visit) have also been shown afecting the health outcomes for which we create a variable measuring after how long this patient is getting admitted again. We also add a variable measuring the number of days a patient has already spent in the hospital/s prior to the current visit, which is another surrogate measure for a patient’s condition. Finally, we also calculate the Charlson Index from the diseases known at the time of admission. As noted earlier, it was calculated as the weighted sum of scores of known diseases as suggested by D’hoore, Sicotte, and Tilquin [18]. The description and summary statistics of the variables are included in Table 3. The set of variables described above (also in Table 3) are collectively referred to as a patient’s characteristics, Pchar.

为了创建预测模型，我们首先从文献综述中讨论的先前研究中确定预测变量。我们的 LOS 模型中使用的过去研究的变量包括： 人口统计变量，例如年龄、性别、婚姻状况和种族；访问信息，例如患者类型（住院或急诊）、入院类型（急诊、紧急、择期、新生儿、创伤中心等）、入院来源（医生转诊、急诊室、诊所转诊、从其他医疗机构转院、从医院转院、在本院出生、正常分娩等）；医院信息，如规模（以床位数量衡量）、急性状况、教学设施、普查区域和城乡状况。此外，有一些证据表明保险类型也会影响 LOS，医疗补助保险持有者的停留时间比其他人更长 [54, 59]。因此，我们也考虑保险类型。此外，亨特利等人。 [36]表明，LOS受到先前入院次数的影响，表明患者病情危重。因此，我们创建一个变量作为衡量患者就诊次数的计数器。此外，再入院天数（当前与上次就诊之间的时间间隔）也被证明会影响健康结果，为此我们创建了一个变量来衡量该患者再次入院多久后的情况。我们还添加了一个变量，用于测量患者在当前就诊之前已在医院度过的天数，这是患者病情的另一个替代指标。最后，我们还根据入院时已知的疾病计算查尔森指数。如前所述，它是按照 D’hoore、Sicotte 和 Tilquin [18] 所建议的已知疾病评分的加权总和来计算的。变量的描述和汇总统计数据包含在表 3 中。上述变量集（也在表 3 中）统称为患者特征 Pchar。

## Predictive Models

## 预测模型

We create models using three sets of variables: patient characteristics, Pchar, known or observed comorbidities, Pres and latent comorbidities, uCOM. To understand the value added by our proposed measure, uCOM, we create a model without uCOM and then a model with uCOM. First, a model of observed diseases (referred to as MPres), is developed where the diseases recorded at the time of admission are modeled, in addition to the Pchar. Therefore, our model of observed comorbidities named MPres, los is a function of patient characteristics, Pchar, and Pres (observed comorbidities) as presented in Equation 5. Then, the measure uCOM is added to MPres to create a model for latent comorbidities named MuCOM as presented in Equation 6. In our model, MuCOM, we propose that combining historical and predicted comorbidities in a two-dimensional comorbidity measurement for a patient in addition to the current diseases will better explain the current state of the patient’s health and therefore, help predict the time needed to take care of this patient in the hospital.

我们使用三组变量创建模型：患者特征、Pchar、已知或观察到的合并症、Pres 和潜在合并症、uCOM。为了了解我们提出的措施 uCOM 所增加的价值，我们创建了一个没有 uCOM 的模型，然后创建了一个包含 uCOM 的模型。首先，除了 Pchar 之外，还开发了观察到的疾病模型（称为 MPres），其中对入院时记录的疾病进行了建模。因此，我们观察到的合并症模型 MPres、los 是患者特征、Pchar 和 Pres（观察到的合并症）的函数，如公式 5 所示。然后，将 uCOM 测量值添加到 MPres 中，以创建名为 MuCOM 的潜在合并症模型，如公式 6 所示。在我们的模型 MuCOM 中，我们建议将历史合并症和预测合并症结合到患者的二维合并症测量中除了当前的疾病之外，还可以更好地解释患者当前的健康状况，因此有助于预测在医院照顾该患者所需的时间。

MPres: los = f(Pchar, Pres)(5)

MuCOM: los = f(Pchar, Pres, uCOM)(6),

where f is a function representing a predictive model. It must be noted that the historical comorbidities would not be available for the patients visiting the hospital for the first time. Therefore, the model using ONLY historical comorbidities will not be applicable to all types of visits. Our two-dimensional comorbidity measurement for a patient at the time of admission using historical and probable comorbidities (The diseases present at the time of admission are included separately in the same model) is practically more robust because it is applicable to all types of hospital visits.

其中 f 是代表预测模型的函数。必须注意的是，首次就诊的患者无法获得既往合并症。因此，仅使用历史合并症的模型并不适用于所有类型的就诊。我们使用历史和可能的合并症（入院时存在的疾病单独包含在同一模型中）对患者入院时的二维合并症测量实际上更加稳健，因为它适用于所有类型的医院就诊。

The deep learning artificial neural network predictive models were created in case of MPres and MuCOM<sup>4</sup> For the latent comorbidity model, MuCOM, a multi-input neural network model containing Long-Short-Term-Memory (LSTM) layer is created. Our twodimensional formulation of latent comorbidities, uCOM, involves a sequence of a presence of a disease in history and future. In other words, that historical comorbidities are used to inform the predicted comorbidities. Therefore, a method such as LSTM is the best to model this sequential data. LSTM, a recurrent neural network (RNN) model was first explained by Hochreiter and Schmidhuber [35]. It is a sequence learning algorithm, which is not sensitive to the gap between data points. It is a gradient-based learning algorithm in which error flows constantly through special self-connected units called as memory cells connected to the regulators such as input gate, forget gate and output gate units. The core of a memory cell is a linear unit called the Constant Error Carousel (CEC) whose activation is called a cell state. The input gate decides whether to keep or override the information in a memory cell, the forget gate is responsible for deciding to keep or forget the information from previous steps, and finally, the output gate controls the output from the memory cell and decides the information to forward to next hidden state. For the mathematical formulation of LSTM, refer to the seminal work by Hochreiter and Schmidhuber [35] and Gers, Schmidhuber and Cummins [28].

针对 MPres 和 MuCOM<sup>4</sup> 创建了深度学习人工神经网络预测模型。对于潜在共病模型 MuCOM，创建了包含长短期记忆 (LSTM) 层的多输入神经网络模型。我们对潜在合并症的二维表述，uCOM，涉及历史和未来疾病存在的序列。换句话说，历史合并症用于告知预测的合并症。因此，像 LSTM 这样的方法是对这种序列数据进行建模的最佳方法。 LSTM 是一种循环神经网络 (RNN) 模型，首先由 Hochreiter 和 Schmidhuber [35] 解释。它是一种序列学习算法，对数据点之间的差距不敏感。它是一种基于梯度的学习算法，其中误差不断地流过特殊的自连接单元，称为存储单元，连接到调节器，例如输入门、遗忘门和输出门单元。存储单元的核心是一个称为恒定误差旋转木马（CEC）的线性单元，其激活称为单元状态。输入门决定是保留还是覆盖存储单元中的信息，遗忘门负责决定保留还是忘记前面步骤中的信息，最后，输出门控制存储单元的输出并决定将信息转发到下一个隐藏状态。有关 LSTM 的数学公式，请参阅 Hochreiter 和 Schmidhuber [35] 以及 Gers、Schmidhuber 和 Cummins [28] 的开创性工作。

## Data Analysis

## 数据分析

We obtained data from the Center for Health Systems Innovation (CHSI), a center at Oklahoma State University that houses and conducts research on data provided by Cerner Corporation, a major Electronic Medical Record (EMR) provider. The data warehouse contains visit records of 58 million unique patients across 662 US hospitals (2000-2015). In the database, the diseases are recorded using the International Classification of Diseases, Ninth Revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-9-CM) till the third quarter of 2015 after which the diseases are required to be recorded using ICD-10 coding system. Therefore, to maintain consistency in our dataset, we use data till the third quarter of 2015. According to ICD-9 coding system, an ICD-9 code has three, four, or five digits, with the first three representing the broader category of a disease, and the fourth and fifth representing sub-divisions of a disease. For example, the ICD-9 code for personality disorder is 301. At four-digit level (301.x), there are ten types of personality disorders and at five-digit level (301.xx), two other specific personality disorders are coded. Notably, we have used an ICD-9 code of a disease at five-digit level, which captures the detailed version of the disease and severity in some cases. In some cases in ICD coding, the detailed version of a disease is at the three- or four-digit level as well. In such cases, the most detailed version at three- or four-digit level are considered. We did not perform any aggregation and used the same version of the disease as noted by the physician. Most of the past research aggregated the ICD-9 codes at the threedigit level to understand the impact of a category of a disease on LOS. However, we used the full ICD code without any aggregation which aligns with the practice and represents the true condition of a patient. We have a total of 15,584 unique diseases across all patients.

我们从俄克拉荷马州立大学健康系统创新中心 (CHSI) 获取数据，该中心保存并研究主要电子病历 (EMR) 提供商 Cerner Corporation 提供的数据。该数据仓库包含 662 家美国医院（2000 年至 2015 年）5800 万个独特患者的就诊记录。在数据库中，截至2015年第三季度，疾病均使用国际疾病分类第九版临床修订版（ICD-9-CM）进行记录，此后疾病需要使用ICD-10编码系统进行记录。因此，为了保持数据集的一致性，我们使用截至2015年第三季度的数据。根据ICD-9编码系统，ICD-9代码有三位、四位或五位数字，前三位代表更广泛的疾病类别，第四和第五位代表疾病的细分类别。例如，人格障碍的 ICD-9 代码是 301。在四位数字级别 (301.x)，有十种类型的人格障碍，在五位数字级别 (301.xx)，编码了另外两种特定的人格障碍。值得注意的是，我们使用了五位数字级别的疾病的 ICD-9 代码，它捕获了疾病的详细版本和某些情况下的严重程度。在某些情况下，在 ICD 编码中，疾病的详细版本也是三位数或四位数级别。在这种情况下，会考虑三位数或四位数级别的最详细版本。我们没有进行任何聚合，并使用了医生指出的相同版本的疾病。过去的大多数研究都汇总了三位数级别的 ICD-9 代码，以了解某一类疾病对 LOS 的影响。然而，我们使用了完整的 ICD 代码，没有任何聚合，这符合实践并代表了患者的真实状况。我们的所有患者总共有 15,584 种独特疾病。

The steps performed in processing the massive dataset containing medical records of 24.7 million unique patients are outlined in a flowchart in Figure 2. The flowchart also presents the number of patients and hospital visits at each step in the process. Briefly, we used information about the demographics of patients, hospitals, types of visits, and diseases. We had 128 million hospital visits with disease records from 24.7 million unique patients. We followed the Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis or Diagnosis (TRIPOD) guidelines created by Collins et al. [15] and CRoss-Industry Standard Process for Data Mining (CRISP-DM) [40, 82] for our analysis. First, information about the patients, admissions, diseases diagnosed, and hospitals were merged. At the disease level, the detailed version of the disease information available includes all ICD codes marked during the visit. The exact date/time of a disease development is understandably missing; nevertheless, the presence of a disease at the time of admission is known. In our study, we used the information about a complete visit to create the networks but used only diseases present during admission for creating predictive models.

图 2 中的流程图概述了处理包含 2470 万独特患者医疗记录的海量数据集时执行的步骤。该流程图还显示了流程中每个步骤的患者数量和医院就诊数量。简而言之，我们使用了有关患者、医院、就诊类型和疾病的人口统计信息。我们的医院就诊次数达 1.28 亿次，拥有 2,470 万名独特患者的疾病记录。我们遵循 Collins 等人创建的个人预后或诊断多变量预测模型透明报告 (TRIPOD) 指南。 [15] 和 CRoss 数据挖掘行业标准流程 (CRISP-DM) [40, 82] 供我们分析。首先，合并患者、入院、诊断的疾病和医院的信息。在疾病层面，可用疾病信息的详细版本包括就诊期间标记的所有 ICD 代码。疾病发生的确切日期/时间缺失，这是可以理解的；尽管如此，入院时已知患有某种疾病。在我们的研究中，我们使用完整就诊的信息来创建网络，但仅使用入院期间存在的疾病来创建预测模型。

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/ba3d1aaf77b120b4cda32c5856d63fbfbd981a15a2f43015c7f7d6f9c3cb55a0.jpg)
Figure 2. Data Processing and Modeling Flowchart

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/ba3d1aaf77b120b4cda32c5856d63fbfbd981a15a2f43015c7f7d6f9c3cb55a0.jpg)
图 2. 数据处理和建模流程图

After data merging, data cleaning was performed that included the validation of the data quality and integrity in the EMR. We restricted our analysis to inpatient and emergency visits with discharges to the patients’ home. Moreover, we considered hospital visits with LOS of at least one day and up to 30 days in order to remove outliers. This step removed about 89.8% of the hospital visits because majority of the hospital visits do not require an overnight stay. CDC also reported a similar number - only 12.4% of emergency visits require a hospital stay<sup>5</sup> Moreover, long-term hospital stays represent a very small percentage of patients [61], and predictive models for such patients may include other signatures. For instance, Spratt et al. found the level of disability after stroke could predict prolonged stays [88]. During the process, records with erroneous and suspicious coding were removed. For instance, there were hospital visits that recorded the admission date/time later than the discharge date/time, and visits where the admission date/time were earlier than the previous discharge date/time. We found a few patients who were coded as male during one visit and female in another and vice versa. These types of challenges are inherent when using secondary data, and are well documented [6, 84]. However, the size of our dataset helps mitigate these issues. After the data selection, we were left with 12.75 million hospital visits by 7.1 million patients. As known from the past research such as Hellervik and Rodgers [33], length of hospital stay follows a power law distribution. We present this analysis in Figure 3 where we confirm that LOS follows a power law curve with a scaling factor of 2.54.

数据合并后，进行数据清理，包括验证 EMR 中的数据质量和完整性。我们的分析仅限于住院和急诊就诊以及出院到患者家中。此外，我们考虑了住院时间至少为 1 天、最长为 30 天的医院就诊，以消除异常值。这一步骤减少了约 89.8% 的医院就诊次数，因为大多数医院就诊不需要过夜。 CDC 也报告了类似的数字 - 只有 12.4% 的紧急就诊需要住院<sup>5</sup>此外，长期住院的患者只占很小的比例 [61]，此类患者的预测模型可能包括其他特征。例如，斯普拉特等人。发现中风后的残疾程度可以预测长期住院[88]。在此过程中，带有错误和可疑编码的记录被删除。例如，有些医院就诊记录的入院日期/时间晚于出院日期/时间，也有医院就诊记录的入院日期/时间早于上次出院日期/时间。我们发现一些患者在一次就诊时被编码为男性，在另一次就诊时被编码为女性，反之亦然。使用二手数据时，这些类型的挑战是固有的，并且有详细记录 [6, 84]。然而，我们数据集的大小有助于缓解这些问题。经过数据筛选后，我们剩下 710 万名患者的 1275 万人次医院就诊次数。从 Hellervik 和 Rodgers 等过去的研究中可知[33]，住院时间遵循幂律分布。我们在图 3 中展示了这一分析，其中我们确认 LOS 遵循比例因子为 2.54 的幂律曲线。

After data cleaning, a random sample of 25% patients including 1.82 million women visits and 1.37 million men visits was extracted to create comorbidity networks. As discussed in the introduction section, we created separate networks for men and women. The network visualizations and network properties are presented in Figure 4. The networks are essentially two matrices (one each for men and women) containing the strength of connections between pairs of diseases. In the male network, 11,898 diseases were present with 249,902 connections whereas in the female network, 12,719 unique diseases were present with 267,170 connections. In both matrices, only the edges occurring more than by chance are considered i.e. where an edge weight is more than the average weight of all edges. Separately, the remaining 75% patients with 9.56 million hospital visits were used for creating predictive models. Note here that there is no overlap of patients in the dataset used for creating the comorbidity networks and predictive models where one patient can have multiple visits. Four diferent sub-datasets were created with diferent information and later merged. First, a table containing a visit-level information was created containing patient demographics, hospital information and admission variables. In another table, the diseases present at the time of admission are stored, which contains the binary codes for all diseases. Here, the maximal set contained 15,584 diseases belonging to both men and women. In the third dataset, the diseases recorded in previous visits of a patient are organized. Here again, 15,584 binary variables are created to measure the past presence of a disease for a patient. Finally, the fourth dataset containing the probable diseases computed from the comorbidity network based on the known diseases was created, which contained 15,584 variables representing COM values.

数据清理后，随机抽取 25% 的患者样本（包括 182 万女性就诊者和 137 万男性就诊者）来创建合并症网络。正如引言部分所讨论的，我们为男性和女性创建了单独的网络。网络可视化和网络属性如图 4 所示。网络本质上是两个矩阵（男性和女性各一个），包含疾病对之间的联系强度。在男性网络中，存在 11,898 种疾病，有 249,902 个连接，而在女性网络中，存在 12,719 种独特疾病，有 267,170 个连接。在这两个矩阵中，仅考虑出现次数多于偶然的边，即边权重大于所有边的平均权重。另外，其余 75% 的患者（956 万次就诊）被用于创建预测模型。请注意，用于创建合并症网络和预测模型的数据集中不存在患者重叠，其中一名患者可以多次就诊。使用不同的信息创建了四个不同的子数据集，然后将其合并。首先，创建一个包含就诊级别信息的表，其中包含患者人口统计数据、医院信息和入院变量。在另一个表中，存储了入院时存在的疾病，其中包含所有疾病的二进制代码。在这里，最大的集合包含 15,584 种属于男性和女性的疾病。在第三个数据集中，组织了患者之前就诊时记录的疾病。这里同样创建了 15,584 个二元变量来衡量患者过去是否患有某种疾病。最后，创建了第四个数据集，其中包含根据已知疾病从合并症网络计算出的可能疾病，其中包含代表 COM 值的 15,584 个变量。

It is well known that the distribution of length of hospital stays is highly right skewed (Hellervik and Rodgers [33]. We analyzed the LOS distribution and found similar results confirming the quality of our dataset. Figure 3a shows the distribution of length of hospital stays of the patients staying less than 30 days in the hospitals. Most of the patients stay for less than 10 days and very few stay longer making a long right tail. This distribution is known as a power law distribution.

众所周知，住院时间的分布是高度右偏的（Hellervik 和 Rodgers [33]。我们分析了 LOS 分布，发现了类似的结果，证实了我们数据集的质量。图 3a 显示了住院时间少于 30 天的患者的住院时间分布。大多数患者住院时间少于 10 天，极少数患者住院时间更长，形成长右尾。这种分布称为幂律分布。

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/80c46f9a0cb55e7e7d5485097f17b7789e2dea81e1e4fa427efdfbe183cfa8c3.jpg)

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/7b9826f323da598f9fed9ba042f5dad7c4503dd754e2c13b3ab4a9cfb4572acf.jpg)
Mathematically, a variable σ follows a power law distribution if it follows

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/7b9826f323da598f9fed9ba042f5dad7c4503dd754e2c13b3ab4a9cfb4572acf.jpg)
在数学上，如果变量 σ 遵循幂律分布，则它遵循

$$
\mathrm{P} (\sigma) \propto \sigma^ {- \gamma},
$$

where P(σ) is the probability of the occurrence of a random variable σ and γ is the scaling factor or an exponent. In our case, the random variable is LOS. If we plot Figure 3a on a log-log scale, the distribution forms an approximate straight line with a slope of – γ, as shown in Figure 3b. In the power law distribution of length of hospital stays, scaling factor (γ) is 2.54. The equation below explains that the power law curve fits the LOS distribution very well as the correlation in the log-log plot in Figure 3b is 0.98. The slope of the line is -2.54 and the intercept is 0.29. Our scaling parameter is consistent with the past research as Hellervik and Rodgers [33] reported an exponent of 2.12.

其中 P(σ) 是随机变量 σ 出现的概率，γ 是比例因子或指数。在我们的例子中，随机变量是 LOS。如果我们在双对数刻度上绘制图 3a，分布会形成一条斜率为 – γ 的近似直线，如图 3b 所示。在住院时间的幂律分布中，比例因子 (γ) 为 2.54。下面的等式说明幂律曲线非常适合 LOS 分布，图 3b 中双对数图中的相关性为 0.98。直线的斜率为-2.54，截距为0.29。我们的缩放参数与过去的研究一致，Hellervik 和 Rodgers [33] 报告的指数为 2.12。

$$
\mathrm{P} (\mathrm{LOS}) = \mathrm{e} ^ {0. 2 9} * (\mathrm{LOS}) ^ {- 2. 5 4}
$$

Figure 3. Distribution of Length of Stay

图 3. 停留时间分布

Next, all four datasets were merged based on the visit identification number. Because patients behave diferently based on the type of diseases they sufer from, we created diferent models for diferent class of patients. The merged dataset was then prepared for modeling. The patients were divided into nineteen categories based upon the diseases present at the admission time defined by organ system they belong to (See Table 4 for the categories). If diseases belong to multiple organ systems, then the record was used in multiple categories. Based on the category of visits, the final dataset was divided into nineteen disease categories to create models for each group of patients. This is the last node in the flowchart in Figure 2. We divided the dataset into nineteen classes because doing so will help us understand the impact of our approach in diferent categories of diseases and compare with the extant models. Notably, although we divided the dataset based on the diseases present, the comorbidities can belong to any disease. Therefore, this categorization approach does not impact the dimensionality of the data. In each case, 70% of the visits were randomly partitioned to train the model and the remaining visits to validate it. More details on the modeling process are included below.

接下来，根据访问标识号合并所有四个数据集。由于患者根据所患疾病的类型而表现不同，因此我们为不同类别的患者创建了不同的模型。然后准备合并的数据集用于建模。根据入院时存在的疾病及其所属器官系统将患者分为十九类（类别见表4）。如果疾病属于多个器官系统，则记录将用于多个类别。根据就诊类别，最终数据集分为 19 个疾病类别，为每组患者创建模型。这是图 2 流程图中的最后一个节点。我们将数据集分为 19 个类别，因为这样做将帮助我们了解我们的方法对不同类别疾病的影响，并与现有模型进行比较。值得注意的是，尽管我们根据存在的疾病划分数据集，但合并症可以属于任何疾病。因此，这种分类方法不会影响数据的维度。在每种情况下，70% 的访问被随机划分以训练模型，其余访问则被随机分配以验证模型。下面包含有关建模过程的更多详细信息。

![](/api/attachments/R29D9YHX/fulltext/images/5f9d0a764a19600f77047de6a67e49e66b6a51f24b6c7ce58c31959e7bfc6657.jpg)
Figure 4. Network visualizations and network properties. Figures 4a and 4b depict the Women and Men comorbidity networks. For visualization only, we removed rare connections using an Ochiai coeficient cut-of of 0.04 as suggested by Kalgotra, et al. [41, 42] due to which the number of connections decreased from 267,170 to 17,544 and 249,902 to 17,298 in women and men respectively. The visualizations in Figures 3a and 3b and properties presented are computed after filtering the rare connections. The layout used for arranging the visuals is Fruchterman Reingold as described by Fruchterman and Reingold [25].

图 4. 网络可视化和网络属性。图 4a 和 4b 描绘了女性和男性合并症网络。仅出于可视化目的，我们按照 Kalgotra 等人的建议，使用 0.04 的 Ochiai 系数截止值删除了罕见连接。 [41, 42] 因此，女性和男性的连接数量分别从 267,170 减少到 17,544，从 249,902 减少到 17,298。图 3a 和 3b 中的可视化以及呈现的属性是在过滤稀有连接后计算的。用于安排视觉效果的布局是 Fruchterman Reingold，如 Fruchterman 和 Reingold [25] 所描述的。

## Deep Learning Models

## 深度学习模型

Deep learning neural network architecture was adapted for our modeling. For the observed comorbidities model, MPres, a fully connected neural network model was created for each category of patients. For each category, the number of input neurons equals to the number of variables in Pchar plus the number of diseases present across all the visits (i.e. universal set of diseases in each category). If the number of distinct diseases recorded across all patients a category is r (where r≤15,584), the total number of input neurons is 48+r, where 48 represents the variables created for seventeen factors described in Table 3. The Pchar variables were rescaled between 0 and 1 using min-max scaler [71], since scales were of diferent range. The loss function considered for selecting the best model was mean absolute error since it is easy to compute, understand and explain. In case of MuCOM, a multi-input neural network model containing Long-Short-Term-Memory (LSTM) layers and fully connected layers was created for each category of patients. For the Pchar variables and observed comorbidities, the same architecture was used as described in MPres. In parallel, the LSTM architecture was used to add the efect of uCOM in the model. The architecture of the model is presented in Table 4. The input to the LSTM layer was a two-dimensional array of shape 2Xr.

深度学习神经网络架构适合我们的建模。对于观察到的合并症模型 MPres，为每一类患者创建了一个完全连接的神经网络模型。对于每个类别，输入神经元的数量等于 Pchar 中的变量数量加上所有访问中存在的疾病数量（即每个类别中的通用疾病集）。如果一个类别的所有患者记录的不同疾病的数量为 r（其中 r≤15,584），则输入神经元的总数为 48+r，其中 48 代表为表 3 中描述的 17 个因素创建的变量。使用最小-最大缩放器 [71] 在 0 和 1 之间重新缩放 Pchar 变量，因为尺度具有不同的范围。用于选择最佳模型的损失函数是平均绝对误差，因为它易于计算、理解和解释。对于 MuCOM，为每一类患者创建了一个包含长短期记忆 (LSTM) 层和全连接层的多输入神经网络模型。对于 Pchar 变量和观察到的合并症，使用了 MPres 中描述的相同架构。同时，使用 LSTM 架构在模型中添加 uCOM 的效果。该模型的架构如表 4 所示。LSTM 层的输入是形状为 2Xr 的二维数组。
