It is evident from the variety of features in the datasets, high-dimensionality of the data, complexity in the data preparation, massive size of the dataset, and complex deep neural network modeling that the entire process required a sizeable computing environment. We list the features of our datasets and computing resources in Appendix C and parameters estimated by our models in Table 4, showing the Big Data nature of our study. The architectures of the deep learning models developed were complex and resource intensive where more than 138.3 million parameters were estimated across all MPres and MuCOM models as listed in Table 4. This 138.3 million is the total number of parameters estimated only in the selected models. However, millions of other parameters were estimated in the models created with diferent architectures before arriving at the final models during hyperparameter tuning.

从数据集中特征的多样性、数据的高维性、数据准备的复杂性、数据集的庞大规模以及复杂的深度神经网络建模可以看出，整个过程需要相当大的计算环境。我们在附录 C 中列出了我们的数据集和计算资源的特征，并在表 4 中列出了我们的模型估计的参数，显示了我们研究的大数据性质。所开发的深度学习模型的架构非常复杂且资源密集，其中在所有 MPres 和 MuCOM 模型中估计了超过 1.383 亿个参数，如表 4 所列。这 1.383 亿是仅在选定模型中估计的参数总数。然而，在超参数调整期间到达最终模型之前，在使用不同架构创建的模型中估计了数百万个其他参数。

## Hyperparameter Tuning and overfitting controlling

## 超参数调优和过拟合控制

Here, we discuss the process of hyperparameter tuning and measures taken to control the model overfitting. For hyperparameter tuning of the Mpres, the grid search method was adapted where one to six hidden layers and 10 to 3000 hidden neurons with a step size of ten in each were compared. A larger number of layers and neurons were leading to overfitting whereas the smaller number of neurons and layers resulted in underfitting. In addition, we compared diferent dropout regularization proportions ranging from 0.3 to 0.7 [89]. The purpose of dropout is to randomly drop a specified proportion of weights at a particular point in the model. The activation functions used in all the layers was Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) which computes max(0,z) meaning the negative output from a node becomes zero and range of output is (0 to ∞). For the MPres, the final model included three hidden layers containing 300, 100 and 100 hidden neurons respectively and a dropout proportion of 0.5 before the output layer. The loss function considered was mean absolute error since it is easy to compute, understand and explain. For the optimization, we compared Adadelta [97] and Adam [45] methods. The architecture, number of input neurons and parameters estimated by each model are listed in Table 4. Appendix D lists the optimizer selected in each model.

在这里，我们讨论超参数调整的过程以及控制模型过拟合所采取的措施。对于 Mpres 的超参数调整，采用了网格搜索方法，其中比较了 1 到 6 个隐藏层和 10 到 3000 个隐藏神经元，每个隐藏神经元的步长为 10。较大数量的层和神经元会导致过度拟合，而较少数量的神经元和层会导致欠拟合。此外，我们还比较了 0.3 到 0.7 范围内的不同 dropout 正则化比例 [89]。 Dropout 的目的是在模型中的特定点随机丢弃指定比例的权重。所有层中使用的激活函数是修正线性单元（ReLU），它计算 max(0,z)，这意味着节点的负输出变为零，输出范围为（0 到 ∞）。对于 MPres，最终模型包括三个隐藏层，分别包含 300、100 和 100 个隐藏神经元，输出层之前的 dropout 比例为 0.5。考虑的损失函数是平均绝对误差，因为它很容易计算、理解和解释。对于优化，我们比较了 Adadelta [97] 和 Adam [45] 方法。表4列出了每个模型估计的架构、输入神经元的数量和参数。附录D列出了每个模型中选择的优化器。

In MuCOM model, the uCOM was added parallelly to the variables in MPres where uCOM was given input to the LSTM layer. In the grid-search, one to 3000 LSTM outputs with a step size of five were tested followed by one to six hidden layers. Since comorbidities can have a diferent impact on diferent categories of patients, diferent models were selected. The models selected are presented in the footnotes of Table and further details are listed in Appendix D. The dropout regularization was used to avoid overfitting [89]. The outputs of two parallel dropout layers: one from MPres architecture and one from LSTM architecture were concatenated. Finally, the information from the Pchar variables, Pres and uCOM was available, which was fed to a fully connected layer with 60 neurons. Since there were multiple features interacting with each other, another dropout layer was added to avoid overfitting. Finally, the output of each model was estimated. The architecture, number of inputs and parameters estimated by each model are listed in Table 4 and the number of neurons and optimizer selected are further added in Appendix D. A similar approach has been used by Ebrahimi, Nunamaker Jr and Chen [21] recently.

在 MuCOM 模型中，uCOM 被并行添加到 MPres 中的变量，其中 uCOM 被输入到 LSTM 层。在网格搜索中，测试了 1 到 3000 个步长为 5 的 LSTM 输出，然后测试了 1 到 6 个隐藏层。由于合并症可能对不同类别的患者产生不同的影响，因此选择了不同的模型。所选模型显示在表的脚注中，进一步的详细信息列在附录 D 中。使用 dropout 正则化来避免过度拟合 [89]。两个并行 dropout 层的输出：一个来自 MPres 架构，一个来自 LSTM 架构，被连接起来。最后，来自 Pchar 变量、Pres 和 uCOM 的信息可用，这些信息被馈送到具有 60 个神经元的全连接层。由于有多个特征相互作用，因此添加了另一个 dropout 层以避免过度拟合。最后，估计每个模型的输出。表 4 列出了每个模型估计的架构、输入数量和参数，附录 D 中进一步添加了所选的神经元数量和优化器。Ebrahimi、Nunamaker Jr 和 Chen [21] 最近使用了类似的方法。

To further confirm the robustness of the parameters selected, we divided the two categories of patients<sup>6</sup> into three sets: development, training and validation where development set was used for hyperparameter tuning. One category was the patients with certain conditions originating in the perinatal period and the second category was the patients with diseases of the sense organs. The best models selected during the parameter tuning using the development set where half the dataset used for training and remaining for validation were the same as the models presented in the Table. The results of diferent parameters of parallel LSTM layer are displayed in Appendix E. The grid values presented in the Appendix E are 1) LSTM outputs (1, 10, 15, 20, 25), 2) neurons in each fully connected layers (10, 20, 100), and 3) optimizer (Adam and Adadelta). The consistency of the results (best models) confirmed our selected architectures to be the best models.

为了进一步确认所选参数的稳健性，我们将两类患者<sup>6</sup>分为三组：开发组、训练组和验证组，其中开发组用于超参数调整。一类是患有围产期某些疾病的患者，第二类是患有感觉器官疾病的患者。使用开发集进行参数调整期间选择的最佳模型，其中一半用于训练的数据集和剩余用于验证的数据集与表中提供的模型相同。并行 LSTM 层的不同参数的结果显示在附录 E 中。附录 E 中呈现的网格值为 1）LSTM 输出（1、10、15、20、25）、2）每个全连接层中的神经元（10、20、100）和 3）优化器（Adam 和 Adadelta）。结果（最佳模型）的一致性证实了我们选择的架构是最佳模型。

A common metric to evaluate the under- and over-fitting in machine learning is the loss function that finds the fit of a model by minimizing the error. In addition, the loss function calculated based on the validation datasets efectively assesses the over- and under-fitting as explained by Kohavi [46]. We used mean absolute error as the loss function where final models were selected based on the minimum value of loss function in the validation dataset. By selecting the model based on validation datasets, we ensured the generalizability of the model while controlling the over and underfitting. Moreover, we have used dropout regularization in our models, which is commonly used to control overfitting in deep learning models [89].

评估机器学习中欠拟合和过拟合的常用指标是损失函数，它通过最小化误差来找到模型的拟合度。此外，根据 Kohavi [46] 的解释，基于验证数据集计算的损失函数可以有效评估过度拟合和欠拟合。我们使用平均绝对误差作为损失函数，其中根据验证数据集中损失函数的最小值选择最终模型。通过基于验证数据集选择模型，我们在控制过拟合和欠拟合的同时保证了模型的通用性。此外，我们在模型中使用了 dropout 正则化，这通常用于控制深度学习模型中的过度拟合[89]。

## Results

## 结果

Before running a predictive model, we were interested in learning the additional variance explained by uCOM in LOS so as to compare the performance of this approach with existing models for understanding variations in LOS. We created hierarchical linear regression models to study the variance explained by three diferent set of variables: patient characteristics, Pchar, known diseases or observed comorbidities, Pres and latent comorbidities, uCOM. The first model, Baseline 1, was created with Pchar and Pres (i.e. variables in MPres). The second model is created using Pchar, Pres and uCOM (i.e. variables in MuCOM). In the second model, uCOM was flattened into one dimensional array with a shape of 1X2r to run a traditional linear model. The average improvement in the variance explained by uCOM was 3.6%, calculated by weighing the number of visits in each category.

在运行预测模型之前，我们有兴趣了解 uCOM 在 LOS 中解释的额外方差，以便将该方法的性能与现有模型进行比较，以了解 LOS 的变化。我们创建了分层线性回归模型来研究由三组不同变量解释的方差：患者特征、Pchar、已知疾病或观察到的合并症、Pres 和潜在合并症、uCOM。第一个模型 Baseline 1 是使用 Pchar 和 Pres（即 MPres 中的变量）创建的。第二个模型是使用 Pchar、Pres 和 uCOM（即 MuCOM 中的变量）创建的。在第二个模型中，uCOM 被展平为形状为 1X2r 的一维数组来运行传统的线性模型。通过权衡每个类别的访问次数计算得出，uCOM 解释的方差平均改善为 3.6%。

The results in Table 5 lists the $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value for two models in each category of patients. Our models outperform the performance of extant models in literature. For example, considering the aggregate performance, Liu et al. [53] created a model using data on 155,474 patients belonging to all categories and found an $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.146. In comparison, our average $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ is 0.439, which is much higher. Second, to compare our models for diferent categories, we identified past studies focusing on patients belonging to a specific category of diseases. Table 5 includes the best reported $\mathrm { \bar { R } } ^ { 2 }$ in each category, to the best of our knowledge. In each category, our model performance is superior to the performance reported by past studies. For instance, Mason et al. [62] created a model for Appendectomy patients with an $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.40. Our equivalent (Category 1) model’s $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value is 0.53. Elixhauser, et al. [22] reported models for patients with breast cancer (our category $2 ~ \mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ is 0.33) with $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.2, diabetes (our category $3 ~ \mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ is 0.37) with $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.2, Acute myocardial infraction (our category 8 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ is 0.28) with $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.13, Asthma (our category 9 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ is 0.48) with $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.17, Diverticulosis (our category 10 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ is 0.40) with $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.38 and Low back Pain (our category 14 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ is 0.48) with $\dot { \mathrm { R } } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.14. Similarly, Chertow, et al. [10] analyzed acute kidney injury patients (category 11 in our case) getting an $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.33 whereas our model for patients with genitourinary disorders had an $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.47. Nordyke et al. [65] reported $\mathrm { R } ^ { \bar { 2 } }$ value of 0.25 for anemia patients whereas our model for blood related disorders (category 4) has an $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ value of 0.41. All these comparisons and others in the table below validate the superiority of our models.

表 5 中的结果列出了每个类别患者中两个模型的 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值。我们的模型优于文献中现有模型的性能。例如，考虑到总体性能，Liu 等人。 [53] 使用属于所有类别的 155,474 名患者的数据创建了一个模型，发现 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.146。相比之下，我们的平均 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 是 0.439，要高得多。其次，为了比较不同类别的模型，我们确定了过去针对特定疾病类别患者的研究。据我们所知，表 5 包括每个类别中报告最好的 $\mathrm { \bar { R } } ^ { 2 }$。在每个类别中，我们的模型性能都优于过去研究报告的性能。例如，梅森等人。 [62]为阑尾切除术患者创建了一个模型，$\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.40。我们的等效（类别 1）模型的 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.53。埃利克斯豪瑟等人。 [22] 报告了乳腺癌患者的模型（我们的类别 $2 ~ \mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 为 0.33），$\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.2，糖尿病患者（我们的类别 $3 ~ \mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 为 0.37），$\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为0.2，急性心肌梗塞（我们的类别 8 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 为 0.28），$\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.13，哮喘（我们的类别 9 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 为 0.48），$\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为0.17，憩室病（我们的类别 10 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 为 0.40），$\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.38，腰痛（我们的类别 14 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 为 0.48），$\dot { \mathrm { R } } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.14。同样，切尔托等人。 [10] 分析了急性肾损伤患者（在我们的案例中为 11 类），其 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.33，而我们的泌尿生殖系统疾病患者模型的 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.47。诺戴克等人。 [65] 报道贫血患者的 $\mathrm { R } ^ { \bar { 2 } }$ 值为 0.25，而我们的血液相关疾病（第 4 类）模型的 $\mathrm { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.41。所有这些比较以及下表中的其他比较都验证了我们模型的优越性。

Since our primary purpose was to create predictive models, we elaborate on the results from the deep neural networks (See Table 6). The loss function during our training was mean absolute error (MAE), so we compare the MAE for MPres and MuCOM deep learning models. Both models of MPres and MuCOM performed well, with MuCOM deep learning neural network outperforming in all categories. The value added by the uCOM construct in terms of MAE was 1.9% (weighted by the number of visits in each category) across all category of patients. In terms of number of days, the improvement in a better forecast of LOS due to uCOM is 244,518 days across all categories of patients. Table 6 includes the improvement in days in each model (calculated by subtracting MAE of MPres from MAE of MuCOM and then multiplying the result with the number of visits in each category). Specifically, uCOM added more value in the LOS prediction for patients admitted due to the disorders of skin and subcutaneous tissue, genitourinary system, sense organs, and mental disorders. On the other hand, uCOM did not contribute much in the patients with disorders of respiratory system, pregnancy, childbirth, and the puerperium, conditions originating in the perinatal period and congenital anomalies. The mean absolute percent error (MAPE) of the best models i.e. MuCOM was also computed, which ranges from 13.5% for the patients admitted due to the disorders of sense organs to 56% for patients admitted due to neoplasms. The weighted average MAPE across all MuCOM models was 29.8%, which is quite low, indicating the superior performance of our models. Many of the previous studies do not report MAPE, but the reported MAPE have ranged from a low of 40% to a high of 65%. Rocheteau, et al. [77] recently reported MAPE of 63%, Lowell and Davis [55] reported MAPE of 65% and Zolbanin et al. [100] reported MAPE of 40.55 %. Compared to these numbers, our average MAPE of 29.8% is superior.

由于我们的主要目的是创建预测模型，因此我们详细说明了深度神经网络的结果（参见表 6）。我们训练期间的损失函数是平均绝对误差 (MAE)，因此我们比较 MPres 和 MuCOM 深度学习模型的 MAE。 MPres 和 MuCOM 的两个模型都表现良好，其中 MuCOM 深度学习神经网络在所有类别中都表现出色。 uCOM 构建在所有类别患者中的 MAE 增值为 1.9%（按每个类别的就诊次数加权）。就天数而言，uCOM 对所有类别患者的 LOS 预测改善了 244,518 天。表 6 包括每个模型的天数改进（通过从 MuCOM 的 MAE 中减去 MPres 的 MAE，然后将结果乘以每个类别的访问次数来计算）。具体来说，uCOM对于因皮肤和皮下组织、泌尿生殖系统、感觉器官和精神障碍而入院的患者的LOS预测增加了更多价值。另一方面，uCOM对于患有呼吸系统疾病、妊娠、分娩和产褥期、围产期疾病和先天性异常的患者没有太大作用。还计算了最佳模型即 MuCOM 的平均绝对百分比误差 (MAPE)，其范围从因感觉器官疾病入院的患者的 13.5% 到因肿瘤入院的患者的 56%。所有 MuCOM 模型的加权平均 MAPE 为 29.8%，相当低，表明我们模型的优越性能。之前的许多研究没有报告 MAPE，但报道的 MAPE 范围从低至 40% 到高至 65%。罗切托等人。 [77] 最近报道 MAPE 为 63%，Lowell 和 Davis [55] 报道 MAPE 为 65%，Zolbanin 等人报道 MAPE 为 65%。 [100]报道 MAPE 为 40.55%。与这些数字相比，我们 29.8% 的平均 MAPE 更为出色。

In Table 6, we observe that the proposed construct has more predictive power in some categories than the others. The results indicate that latent comorbidities improved the predictive performance for the patients admitted with disorders representing symptoms as these are likely to be diagnosed with other critical diseases, which would be ultimately responsible for the hospital stay. For instance, the latent comorbidities improve the prediction in the patients admitted with the disorders of sense organs by 8.89%, and by 5.6% in the patients with the diseases of skin and subcutaneous tissue. On the other hand, for the patients admitted with neoplasm, respiratory disorders and circulatory disorders, the latent comorbidities did not contribute substantially to impact the forecast of the hospital stay. A potential explanation for this may be that certain diseases are chronic or even terminal, whereas other diseases (such as the diseases of sense organs) may be more like symptoms that may lead to other comorbidities being discovered and thus the model is able to provide a greater contribution to the predictive power. With respect to diferences in the MAPE, the models with lower MAPE indicates that our model has been able to capture the variations in the data. In other words, prediction of the LOS is a less complex problem for patients with lower MAPE than other patients. On the other hand, the models with higher MAPE indicate that the patients have more variation and there may be other unknown factors that afect the actual LOS.

在表 6 中，我们观察到所提出的结构在某些类别中比其他类别具有更强的预测能力。结果表明，潜在的合并症提高了对患有代表症状的疾病的患者的预测性能，因为这些患者很可能被诊断出患有其他严重疾病，这最终将导致住院。例如，潜在合并症将感觉器官疾病患者的预测提高了 8.89%，将皮肤和皮下组织疾病患者的预测提高了 5.6%。另一方面，对于因肿瘤、呼吸系统疾病和循环系统疾病入院的患者，潜在的合并症对住院时间的预测影响不大。对此的一个潜在解释可能是，某些疾病是慢性的，甚至是晚期的，而其他疾病（例如感觉器官的疾病）可能更像是可能导致其他合并症被发现的症状，因此该模型能够为预测能力提供更大的贡献。对于 MAPE 的差异，具有较低 MAPE 的模型表明我们的模型已经能够捕获数据的变化。换句话说，与其他患者相比，对于 MAPE 较低的患者来说，LOS 的预测是一个不太复杂的问题。另一方面，具有较高 MAPE 的模型表明患者具有更多变异，并且可能存在其他影响实际 LOS 的未知因素。

To further understand the variation in the performance of our models, we calculated the Pearson correlation coeficient between the coeficient of variation of LOS (ratio of standard deviation to mean) and the percentage improvement by the proposed construct in nineteen models. The coeficient of variation measures the dispersion of values of a variable around the mean. In other words, it quantifies the heterogeneity or complexity of the problem. We found a significant positive correlation of 0.34 $( \mathrm { n } { = } 1 9 , \mathrm { t } { = } 1 . 5 , \mathrm { p } { = } 0 . 0 7 6 )$ at the significance level of 0.1<sup>7</sup>, which indicates that our proposed construct improved the prediction performance better in the models for an outcome variable with higher dispersion than for an outcome variable with less dispersion. This finding suggests that our proposed deep learning predictive models work well in the complex problems where the dispersion of outcome variable is high, typically a more challenging situation for machine learning. Although this finding should be validated by employing a similar comparison in other problem domains, it is interesting to realize that the combination of a new construct to predict future state of predictor variables and deep learning modeling may lead to better prediction outcomes when the dependent variable is highly dispersed.

为了进一步了解模型性能的变化，我们计算了 LOS 变异系数（标准差与平均值的比率）与所提出的结构在 19 个模型中的改进百分比之间的皮尔逊相关系数。变异系数衡量变量值在平均值周围的分散程度。换句话说，它量化了问题的异质性或复杂性。我们发现显着性正相关性为 0.34 $( \mathrm { n } { = } 1 9 , \mathrm { t } { = } 1 . 5 , \mathrm { p } { = } 0 . 0 7 6 )$ 在显着性水平 0.1<sup>7</sup> 上，这表明我们提出的结构在模型中更好地提高了结果变量的预测性能离差小于离差较小的结果变量。这一发现表明，我们提出的深度学习预测模型在结果变量离散程度较高的复杂问题中表现良好，这通常是机器学习更具挑战性的情况。尽管这一发现应该通过在其他问题领域进行类似的比较来验证，但有趣的是，当因变量高度分散时，预测预测变量未来状态的新结构与深度学习模型的结合可能会带来更好的预测结果。

We also present another metric to understand the performance of our models considering the error with a tolerance of zero and one day in Table 6. This follows a similar analysis reported by other LOS researchers such as Tsai et al. [93]. The predicted values of LOS were rounded of to integers to compute these metrics. The number with tolerance of zero day implies the number of visits diagnosed with exact value i.e. if a patient stayed for six days, our model predicted six days. Similarly, tolerance of one day means the predicted value has maximum error of one day. In other words, the prediction is within the margin of ±1 day. For instance, the model for patients with infectious and parasitic diseases predicted an exact LOS figure for 52.3% of the visits in the validation dataset, whereas the number increases to 69.7% if an error of one day is allowed. Our models did a good job in predicting exact number for visits with Injury and poisoning (81.8%), diseases of the sense organs (81.8%) and diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue (73%). With tolerance of one day in error, these numbers rise to 92.1%, 91% and 87.8% respectively. These numbers indicate a high performance by our models. On the other hand, the models with the lowest performance in terms of tolerance of zero and one day are neoplasms where 27.9% visits are predicted with the exact LOS number and 59.4% if one day error is neglected. The numbers are low for the visits with diseases of the blood and blood-forming organs, diseases of the circulatory system, congenital anomalies and endocrine, nutritional and immunity disorders. Across all categories of patients, our models predicted 58% of visits with the observed LOS. When an error of one day is allowed, our models predicted 79.8% of visits accurately. These numbers are superior to those reported by Tsai et al. [93] where the authors reported an accuracy of 36% without any error margin. With a tolerance of one day, Tsai et al. reported an accuracy of 67%. Clearly, our models’ predictive performance is superior.

我们还提出了另一个指标来了解我们的模型的性能，考虑到表 6 中零和一天容差的误差。这是在 Tsai 等人等其他 LOS 研究人员报告的类似分析之后进行的。 [93]。 LOS 的预测值四舍五入为整数以计算这些指标。零日容差的数字意味着以精确值诊断的就诊次数，即如果患者住院六天，我们的模型预测六天。同样，一天的容差意味着预测值的最大误差为一天。换句话说，预测的误差在±1 天之内。例如，传染病和寄生虫病患者的模型预测了验证数据集中 52.3% 的访问的准确 LOS 数字，而如果允许一天的误差，该数字会增加到 69.7%。我们的模型在预测受伤和中毒（81.8%）、感觉器官疾病（81.8%）以及肌肉骨骼系统和结缔组织疾病（73%）的确切就诊人数方面做得很好。如果允许一天的错误，这些数字分别上升到 92.1%、91% 和 87.8%。这些数字表明我们的模型具有高性能。另一方面，在零天和一天的容忍度方面性能最低的模型是肿瘤，其中 27.9% 的访问次数是用准确的 LOS 数预测的，如果忽略一天误差则为 59.4%。血液及造血器官疾病、循环系统疾病、先天性异常、内分泌、营养、免疫疾病等就诊人数较少。在所有类别的患者中，我们的模型预测 58% 的就诊具有观察到的 LOS。当允许一天的误差时，我们的模型准确预测了 79.8% 的访问。这些数字优于 Tsai 等人报告的数字。 [93] 作者报告的准确度为 36%，没有任何误差范围。 Tsai 等人以一天的容忍度。报道称准确率为 67%。显然，我们的模型的预测性能非常出色。

To understand the impact of diferent variables on the predicted length of stay, we conducted a feature ranking analysis by using a method described by Kraskov et al. [47] and Ross [79]. It is a nonparametric method based on the entropy estimates from z-nearest neighbor distances (we used z=3). We note that uCOM was flattened from a two-dimensional array to one dimensional array as the feature ranking method adopted requires onedimension array as inputs. In Appendix F, we list top ten features in each category of patients. In majority of the categories, the patient type, age and Charlson index have appeared to be highly important. In addition, the results indicate that probable comorbidities play an important role in predicting LOS. For instance, fever and other physiologic disturbances of temperature regulation during hospitalization is likely to increase LOS in patients admitted due to infection, a finding also reported by Diringer et al. [20]. Similarly, probable pneumonia in patients with disorders of respiratory system can impact the LOS. In patients with conditions originating in the perinatal period, we found probable jaundice can afect the length of stay, a finding supported by the previous research [60]. Other common probable comorbidities across the group of patients are esophagus reflux, heart failure, coronary atherosclerosis and acute kidney failure. Please refer to Appendix F for a complete list of top variables in each category.

为了了解不同变量对预测停留时间的影响，我们使用 Kraskov 等人描述的方法进行了特征排名分析。 [47]和罗斯[79]。它是一种基于 z 最近邻距离（我们使用 z=3）的熵估计的非参数方法。我们注意到，uCOM 从二维数组扁平化为一维数组，因为采用的特征排序方法需要一维数组作为输入。在附录 F 中，我们列出了每类患者的十大特征。在大多数类别中，患者类型、年龄和查尔森指数似乎非常重要。此外，结果表明可能的合并症在预测 LOS 中发挥着重要作用。例如，Diringer 等人也报道了这一发现，住院期间发烧和其他体温调节的生理紊乱可能会增加因感染而入院的患者的 LOS。 [20]。同样，患有呼吸系统疾病的患者可能患有肺炎也会影响 LOS。在患有围产期疾病的患者中，我们发现可能的黄疸会影响住院时间，这一发现得到了先前研究的支持[60]。该组患者其他常见的可能合并症包括食管反流、心力衰竭、冠状动脉粥样硬化和急性肾衰竭。请参阅附录 F，了解每个类别中顶级变量的完整列表。

## Discussion

## 讨论

One of the strengths of our network method, and in particular the model using latent comorbidities, is that it includes multiple diseases, and can therefore, capture multiple interactions. Network positions of diseases were used to identify other diseases that can occur with the observed diseases and help predict LOS. In addition, the multidimensionality nature of our construct, uCOM, including history and probable diseases together made it applicable to all visits because it would not have been applicable for the first hospital visit of a patient if it included only historical diseases (Of course, the first visit has no history information). Furthermore, our construct is flexible and expandable to incorporate additional dimensions.

我们的网络方法（特别是使用潜在合并症的模型）的优势之一是它包含多种疾病，因此可以捕获多种相互作用。疾病的网络位置用于识别可能与观察到的疾病一起发生的其他疾病，并帮助预测 LOS。此外，我们的构造 uCOM 的多维性质，包括病史和可能的疾病，使其适用于所有就诊，因为如果仅包括历史疾病，则它不适用于患者的首次医院就诊（当然，第一次就诊没有病史信息）。此外，我们的结构是灵活且可扩展的，以纳入额外的维度。

## Practical and theoretical implications

## 实践和理论意义

Our LOS prediction approach using the features extracted from the inferred network improved the model performance in all patient categories. Notably, the MPres model, which is considered the baseline is our own contribution. We combined variables that have been employed in multiple past papers and created deep learning models using the combination of these variables. Thus, our baseline model in itself is a summary of much of the previous research in LOS modeling and an application of deep learning to this problem domain, providing a tougher baseline model to beat. Comparing our models to the past studies in terms of performance, these performed better overall, explaining variance in the data ranging from 28% to 65% using the information present at the time of admission with an average $\mathbf { \bar { R } } ^ { 2 }$ of 0.439. The MAPE ranges from 13.8% to 56% with an average value of 29.8%. The MAE of our models ranged from 0.41 days to 2.02 days with an average value of 1.02 days, which is quite low. The value added by latent comorbidities construct, uCOM, in MAE was 1.9%. Although this improvement may appear small, its practical impact is significant. In terms of number of days improved due to uCOM, it amounts to a better forecast of 244,518 days, equivalent to over 88,278 visits when computed by considering the average LOS in each category of patients. Pfuntner, Wier, and Steiner estimated that the aggregate cost for all hospital stays was \$387.3 billion in 2011 with a mean of \$10,000 per stay [72]. This implies that the value added by our method in a more accurate LOS forecast equates to approximately \$882.8 million. Given the size of payments from insurance companies and Medicare to hospitals, an improvement of 1.9% in predicted LOS is equivalent to a better forecast of transfers of \$882.8M. In other words, our proposed comorbidity variables add \$882.8M to the forecast accuracy of cash flows between healthcare payers and providers. Therefore, the practical improvement due to our construct is significant. Because the problem of LOS prediction is particularly wicked (the term used by Gupta [30] in his ISR editorial), notorious and ill-structured, any reasonable improvement in the accuracy is highly desirable. In a wicked complex problem, we need to focus not on a percent change, but the practical implication of that percent gain. For example, in a study on predicting demand of books, Dhar et al. observed improvement of only 0.00035 in mean squared error [17]. However, it was deemed practically significant due to the large volume.

我们的 LOS 预测方法使用从推断网络中提取的特征，提高了所有患者类别的模型性能。值得注意的是，被视为基线的 MPres 模型是我们自己的贡献。我们结合了过去多篇论文中使用的变量，并使用这些变量的组合创建了深度学习模型。因此，我们的基线模型本身是对 LOS 建模以及深度学习在该问题领域的应用的大量先前研究的总结，提供了一个更难击败的基线模型。将我们的模型与过去的研究在性能方面进行比较，这些模型总体表现更好，使用入院时提供的信息解释了 28% 到 65% 的数据方差，平均 $\mathbf { \bar { R } } ^ { 2 }$ 为 0.439。 MAPE 范围为 13.8% 至 56%，平均值为 29.8%。我们模型的 MAE 范围为 0.41 天到 2.02 天，平均值为 1.02 天，相当低。潜在合并症结构 uCOM 在 MAE 中的增加值是 1.9%。尽管这种改进可能看起来很小，但其实际影响却是巨大的。就 uCOM 带来的改善天数而言，更好的预测为 244,518 天，根据每类患者的平均 LOS 计算，相当于超过 88,278 次就诊。 Pfuntner、Wier 和 Steiner 估计 2011 年所有住院的总费用为 3,873 亿美元，平均每次住院费用为 10,000 美元 [72]。这意味着我们的方法在更准确的 LOS 预测中增加的价值约为 8.828 亿美元。考虑到保险公司和医疗保险向医院支付的金额，预测 LOS 提高 1.9% 相当于更好的预测转移金额为 8.828 亿美元。换句话说，我们提出的合并症变量使医疗保健支付者和提供者之间现金流的预测准确性增加了 8.828 亿美元。因此，我们的构造带来的实际改进是显着的。因为 LOS 预测问题特别棘手（Gupta [30] 在他的 ISR 社论中使用的术语）、臭名昭著且结构不良，所以任何对准确性的合理改进都是非常可取的。在一个棘手的复杂问题中，我们需要关注的不是百分比变化，而是百分比增益的实际含义。例如，在一项预测书籍需求的研究中，Dhar 等人。观察到均方误差仅改善了 0.00035 [17]。然而，由于体积大，它被认为具有实际意义。

The use of our model to predict LOS can help hospitals better plan and allocate resources. In addition, the study of comorbidities can certainly help in clinical care and management [94]. Knowledge of the relationships among diseases can help predict and diagnose likely co-existing diseases, and disease network properties can help physicians prioritize treatment of diseases based on the position of a disease in the network. Based on the probable diseases, these networks can help providers select the best treatment plans. The relationships among diseases can also help pharmaceutical companies consider multiple related diseases when developing new drugs.

使用我们的模型预测LOS可以帮助医院更好地规划和分配资源。此外，对合并症的研究当然可以帮助临床护理和管理[94]。了解疾病之间的关系可以帮助预测和诊断可能共存的疾病，疾病网络属性可以帮助医生根据疾病在网络中的位置确定疾病治疗的优先顺序。根据可能的疾病，这些网络可以帮助提供者选择最佳的治疗计划。疾病之间的关系还可以帮助制药公司在开发新药时考虑多种相关疾病。

Our major contribution is in extending the use of network methodology and present its applicability in predictive modeling. Specifically, through our approach, we present a coupling of implicit network modeling and deep learning LSTM modeling, which helped us in making predictions using a complex system of disease-interactions. In addition, we found that the proposed deep learning approach performs better for the outcome with high dispersion than the outcome with less dispersion. Our paper has both theory and method innovations where properties of a complex system were inferred using network methodology, and later used to make predictions of attributes (such as LOS) of the entities (such as patients) from where the complex system (disease-interactions) emerged. The method proposed in this study is generalizable to other problems. For instance, our method can be used to predict readmission rate, mortality and other health outcomes of patients by considering the comorbidities not apparent at the time of admission to a hospital. As noted in Introduction, the method is also applicable to many other business problems where a large dataset can be employed to learn inferred relationships among the activities, and then the resultant network model becomes one of the predictor constructs for modeling an external outcome.

我们的主要贡献是扩展网络方法的使用并展示其在预测建模中的适用性。具体来说，通过我们的方法，我们提出了隐式网络建模和深度学习 LSTM 建模的耦合，这有助于我们使用复杂的疾病相互作用系统进行预测。此外，我们发现所提出的深度学习方法对于高离散度的结果比离散度较小的结果表现更好。我们的论文在理论和方法上都有创新，其中使用网络方法推断复杂系统的属性，然后用于预测复杂系统（疾病相互作用）出现的实体（例如患者）的属性（例如LOS）。本研究提出的方法可以推广到其他问题。例如，我们的方法可以通过考虑入院时不明显的合并症来预测患者的再入院率、死亡率和其他健康结果。如简介中所述，该方法还适用于许多其他业务问题，其中可以使用大型数据集来学习活动之间的推断关系，然后生成的网络模型成为用于对外部结果进行建模的预测器构造之一。

## Limitations and future research

## 局限性和未来研究

Like most research, our study has a few limitations. First, comorbidities were measured based on electronic medical records and therefore, only the diseases recorded in the hospitals’ EMR were included. A patient could go to a hospital with a diferent EMR system, could move from a diferent part of the country and the historical diseases data may not be available to the Cerner EMR. It is perhaps impossible to capture someone’s lifetime medical history in one record in many open societies. Hence, this limitation exists in all studies that are based on medical records. It is certainly our hope that by employing millions of patient encounters to build likely historical and probable comorbidities, we have a better model than any model based on a small dataset. Second, we considered gender diferences while developing comorbidity networks. However, we also recognize that health disparities also exist based on race and ethnicity [24–25, 42]. We included race as a factor in the model but comorbidity networks by race difer as well, as reported in a paper in Scientific Reports by Kalgotra et al. [42]. Including such disparities is a next step of our research. Third, our models showed a more accurate forecast with respect to the existing models, but there is still room for improvement. We did not use patients’ laboratory reports or consider other external factors such as hospital conditions, level of care and quality of physicians, which could make a significant diference. Due to HIPAA regulations, the location and time related variables were not used in this study. Moreover, a physician or hospital may difer in their treatment styles. These diferences in treatment styles which are likely not fully recorded in an EHR illustrate the complex nature of the LOS prediction problem. Such diferences in treatment styles as well as of course, patients’ genetic characteristics lead to the dificulty of providing a more accurate LOS prediction at the time of a patient’s admission. This means that there will always be a major variation in LOS prediction, and any small gains in accuracy are still quite significant. Although not at the physician level, we have considered hospital level factors such as size, teaching or not, etc. in our model to control for some of these efects. Moreover, creating the latent comorbidities construct from a large dataset is likely to mitigate the impact of treatment diferences.

与大多数研究一样，我们的研究也有一些局限性。首先，合并症是根据电子病历来衡量的，因此只包括医院电子病历中记录的疾病。患者可能会去具有不同 EMR 系统的医院，可能来自该国的不同地区，并且 Cerner EMR 可能无法获得历史疾病数据。在许多开放社会中，在一份记录中记录某人一生的病史也许是不可能的。因此，所有基于医疗记录的研究都存在这种局限性。我们当然希望，通过利用数百万患者的接触来建立可能的历史和可能的合并症，我们拥有比任何基于小数据集的模型更好的模型。其次，我们在开发合并症网络时考虑了性别差异。然而，我们也认识到，基于种族和民族的健康差异也存在[24-25, 42]。我们将种族作为模型中的一个因素，但不同种族的合并症网络也有所不同，正如 Kalgotra 等人在《科学报告》中的一篇论文所报道的那样。 [42]。纳入此类差异是我们研究的下一步。第三，我们的模型相对于现有模型显示出更准确的预测，但仍有改进的空间。我们没有使用患者的实验室报告，也没有考虑其他外部因素，例如医院条件、护理水平和医生质量，这些因素可能会产生重大影响。由于 HIPAA 法规，本研究中未使用位置和时间相关变量。此外，医生或医院的治疗方式可能有所不同。这些治疗方式的差异可能没有完全记录在 EHR 中，这说明了 LOS 预测问题的复杂性。治疗方式的差异以及患者的遗传特征导致难以在患者入院时提供更准确的 LOS 预测。这意味着 LOS 预测始终会存在重大变化，并且准确性的任何微小提升仍然相当显着。尽管不是在医生层面，但我们在模型中考虑了医院层面的因素，例如规模、教学与否等，以控制其中一些影响。此外，从大型数据集创建潜在的合并症结构可能会减轻治疗差异的影响。

Fourth, we randomly partitioned the data for training and validating the models. In future, we plan to use other partitioning approaches as suggested by Zolbanin et al [100]. Fifth, LOS for visits with multiple known diseases belonging to diferent organ systems was predicted by multiple models. However, this limitation is mitigated by the fact that each visit at the end is classified into one Major Diagnostic Category (MDC) code. Sixth, we selected top five connections to predict the probable comorbidities. The choice of how many probable comorbidities to consider in a predictive model remains an empirical and theoretical research issue. It is a tradeof between parsimony of a model and its predictive performance. Finally, we employed our proposed approach to predict LOS; in the future, this approach can also be used it to predict other medical outcomes such as readmission and mortality.

第四，我们随机划分数据以训练和验证模型。将来，我们计划使用 Zolbanin 等人[100]建议的其他分区方法。第五，多种模型预测了属于不同器官系统的多种已知疾病的 LOS。然而，由于每次访问最后都会被分类到一个主要诊断类别 (MDC) 代码中，这一限制得到了缓解。第六，我们选择前五个连接来预测可能的合并症。选择在预测模型中考虑多少种可能的合并症仍然是一个实证和理论研究问题。这是模型的简约性与其预测性能之间的权衡。最后，我们采用我们提出的方法来预测 LOS；将来，这种方法还可用于预测其他医疗结果，例如再入院和死亡率。

## Conclusion

## 结论

Patients, medical providers, and insurance companies all want to know when a hospitalized patient can be discharged. Predicting hospital LOS is a complex and ill-structured problem. In this paper, we have presented a novel model to predict the expected LOS at the time of admission by using a construct of latent comorbidities comprising historical and probable comorbidities. The probable comorbidities were derived from the network analysis. This construct of latent comorbidities was employed in deep learning models to predict patients LOS using almost 10 million other patient visits belonging to various disease categories. The average mean absolute percent error of our models across all categories of diseases was 29.8%, lower than any existing models. Our primary contribution is in developing a generalizable method to create a predictor construct for recognizing underlying relationships through network analyses, which can then be used in a deep learning model to predict an exogenous dependent variable. Thus, our study adds to the growing literature of information systems, analytics, comorbidity, and network science.

患者、医疗服务提供者和保险公司都想知道住院患者何时可以出院。预测医院服务水平是一个复杂且结构不良的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的模型，通过使用包含历史和可能合并症的潜在合并症结构来预测入院时的预期 LOS。可能的合并症来自网络分析。这种潜在合并症的构造被应用于深度学习模型中，通过近 1000 万属于不同疾病类别的其他患者就诊来预测患者 LOS。我们的模型在所有疾病类别中的平均绝对百分比误差为 29.8%，低于任何现有模型。我们的主要贡献是开发一种可推广的方法来创建一个预测器构造，用于通过网络分析识别潜在关系，然后可以在深度学习模型中使用该预测器构造来预测外生因变量。因此，我们的研究丰富了信息系统、分析、共病和网络科学方面不断增长的文献。

Pankush Kalgotra is an Assistant Professor of Business Analytics at Auburn University. He earned his Ph.D. in Management Science and Information Systems from Oklahoma State University. His research interests include healthcare analytics, network science, neuroimaging in information systems, and the dark side of information technology. Dr. Kalgotra’s recent papers have appeared in journals such as Journal of Business Research, Nature: Scientific Reports, International Journal of Medical Informatics, Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine, Decision Sciences Journal of Innovative Education and others

Pankush Kalgotra 是奥本大学商业分析助理教授。他获得了博士学位。俄克拉荷马州立大学管理科学与信息系统博士。他的研究兴趣包括医疗保健分析、网络科学、信息系统中的神经影像以及信息技术的阴暗面。 Kalgotra 博士最近的论文发表在《商业研究杂志》、《自然：科学报告》、《国际医学信息学杂志》、《生物医学计算机方法和程序》、《决策科学创新教育杂志》等期刊上

Ramesh Sharda is the Vice Dean for Research and Graduate Programs, Watson/ConocoPhillips Chair and a Regents Professor of Management Science and Information Systems in the Spears School of Business at Oklahoma State University. His research has been published in major journals in management science and information systems including Management Science, Information Systems Research, Journal of Management Information Systems, Operations Research Nature: Scientific Reports, INFORMS Journal on Computing, and many others. Dr. Sharda has coauthored two textbooks: Analytics, Data Science, and Artificial Intelligence: Systems for Decision Support, 11th edition, and Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Data Science: A Managerial Perspective, 4th edition. He is a member of several editorial boards, served as the Executive Director of Teradata University Network, and was inducted into the Oklahoma Higher Education Hall of Fame. Dr. Sharda is a Fellow of INFORMS and AIS.

# 第 7 篇 / Article 7: Eyes wide open: The role of situational information security awareness for security‐related behaviour

WILEY

威利

# Eyes wide open: The role of situational information security awareness for security-related behaviour

# 睁大眼睛：情境信息安全意识对安全相关行为的作用

Lennart Jaeger<sup>1</sup> | Andreas Eckhardt<sup>2</sup>

Lennart Jaeger<sup>1</sup> |安德烈亚斯·埃克哈特<sup>2</sup>

<sup>1</sup>Lecturer in Information Security, Governance and Leadership, Department of Business Information Systems, University of Queensland, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia <sup>2</sup>Professor of Information Systems, Faculty of Business and Management, University of Innsbruck, Innsbruck, Austria

<sup>1</sup>澳大利亚昆士兰州布里斯班昆士兰大学商业信息系统系信息安全、治理和领导力讲师 <sup>2</sup>奥地利因斯布鲁克大学商业与管理学院信息系统教授

## 一致

Lennart Jaeger, Lecturer in Information Security, Governance and Leadership, Department of Business Information Systems, University of Queensland, Brisbane, QLD 4072, Australia. Email: l.jaeger@business.uq.edu.au

Lennart Jaeger，昆士兰大学商业信息系统系信息安全、治理和领导力讲师，澳大利亚布里斯班，QLD 4072。电子邮件：l.jaeger@business.uq.edu.au

## Abstract

## 抽象的

Most contemporary studies on information security focus on largely static phenomena in examining security-related behaviours. We take a more dynamic, situational and interactionist approach that proposes that security-related behaviours result from an interaction between the person and the perception of a threatening situation. We derive and define situational information security awareness based on situation awareness literature, and examine how individuallevel (innate traits, experience) and system-level factors (design variations, warning signal) influence awareness, and how it influences subsequent threat and coping appraisals, and ultimately security-related behaviours in a multi-method phishing experiment including eye tracking and survey components with 107 employees. The results underscore the importance of situational information security awareness and show that past experience with phishing and a security warning increase awareness, while phishing emails' contextual relevance and misplaced salience decrease awareness. Situational information security awareness, in turn, increases perceived threat and perceived coping efficacy and, ultimately, actual behavioural responses to phishing attacks.

大多数当代信息安全研究主要集中在检查安全相关行为时的静态现象。我们采取一种更加动态、情景化和互动主义的方法，认为与安全相关的行为是人与威胁情况感知之间相互作用的结果。我们根据态势感知文献推导和定义态势信息安全意识，并研究个人层面（先天特征、经验）和系统层面因素（设计变化、警告信号）如何影响意识，以及它如何影响后续威胁和应对评估，以及最终在多方法网络钓鱼实验中影响安全相关行为，其中包括 107 名员工的眼动追踪和调查组件。结果强调了情境信息安全意识的重要性，并表明过去的网络钓鱼经验和安全警告可以提高意识，而网络钓鱼电子邮件的上下文相关性和错误的显着性会降低意识。情境信息安全意识反过来会增加感知威胁和感知应对功效，并最终提高对网络钓鱼攻击的实际行为响应。

## K E Y W O R D S

contextual relevance, eye tracking, misplaced salience, phishing, security warning, situational information security awareness

上下文相关性、眼球追踪、错位显着性、网络钓鱼、安全警告、态势信息安全意识

## 1 | INTRODUCTION

## 1 |介绍

Phishing emails have been common for decades and are considered a top security threat by both security researchers and governmental authorities, who expect the problem to get even worse (Erb, 2018; Landewe, 2019). The reason is quite simple: the majority of phishing-related incidents are attributed to the often unaware behaviour of individuals who regularly fall prey to phishing attacks (Hong, 2012). Many of the most devastating security attack in history, such as the Locky ransomware attacks, had their roots in a phishing email (Mathews, 2017). In this case, a single email opened by a single user with sufficient access to an organization's server enabled cyber attackers to hold large volumes of encrypted data for ransom. Consequently, cybersecurity researchers (Kaspersky Lab, 2019; Palmer, 2016) and governmental authorities (Chanthadavong, 2017; Erb, 2018) have issued warnings about thi increasing threat to corporate and public sector networks. Because the sole reliance on security software (eg, spam filter) to prevent phishing attacks does not provide sufficient protection, the burden of detecting and coping with phishing remains on the shoulders of the individual user (Wang, Li, & Rao, 2017)

网络钓鱼电子邮件几十年来一直很常见，安全研究人员和政府当局都将其视为首要安全威胁，他们预计问题会变得更加严重（Erb，2018；Landewe，2019）。原因很简单：大多数与网络钓鱼相关的事件都是由于经常遭受网络钓鱼攻击的个人的不知情行为造成的（Hong，2012）。历史上许多最具破坏性的安全攻击，例如 Locky 勒索软件攻击，都源于网络钓鱼电子邮件（Mathews，2017）。在这种情况下，具有对组织服务器的足够访问权限的单个用户打开的一封电子邮件使网络攻击者能够持有大量加密数据以获取赎金。因此，网络安全研究人员（卡巴斯基实验室，2019 年；Palmer，2016 年）和政府当局（Chanthadavong，2017 年；Erb，2018 年）针对企业和公共部门网络面临的日益严重的威胁发出了警告。由于仅依靠安全软件（例如垃圾邮件过滤器）来防止网络钓鱼攻击并不能提供足够的保护，因此检测和应对网络钓鱼的负担仍然落在个人用户的肩上（Wang、Li 和 Rao，2017）

The dominant assumption in information security research is that individuals are rational actors who deliberatel plan their behaviours in advance and are aware of the benefits and costs of their responses (Dennis & Minas, 2018) For example, information security awareness, defined as general knowledge about information security and cogni zance of one's organizations security policies, represents a key element in the formation of beliefs, attitudes and intentions towards policy compliance (Bulgurcu, Cavusoglu, & Benbasat, 2010). Appendix A provides additional con ceptualizations of information security awareness. While these conceptualizations differ according to their stud context, they have the common denominator of being considered as a product, that is, a state of knowledge. While the assumption of the aware user may hold true in some information security contexts, such static, pre-conceived notions of awareness are less appropriate to capture the role that a situation plays in influencing awareness and sub sequent behaviours. This is because static awareness concepts are most often formed before individuals actually per form security-related behaviours and thus do not reflect the situation-specific facets of the process individual follow while performing them. For example, users may generally be aware about the security threat of phishing but may still click on unknown links or attachments due to a lack of situation-specific awareness of the threat (Alsharnouby, Alaca, & Chiasson, 2015; Dhamija, Tygar, & Hearst, 2006; Moody, Galletta, & Dunn, 2017)

信息安全研究的主要假设是，个人是理性的行为者，他们提前深思熟虑地计划自己的行为，并了解其应对措施的收益和成本（Dennis & Minas，2018）例如，信息安全意识，定义为有关信息安全的一般知识和对组织安全政策的认知，代表了形成政策合规信念、态度和意图的关键要素（Bulgurcu、Cavusoglu 和 Benbasat， 2010）。附录 A 提供了信息安全意识的附加概念。虽然这些概念根据其种马背景而有所不同，但它们有一个共同点，即被视为产品，即知识状态。虽然有意识的用户的假设在某些信息安全环境中可能成立，但这种静态的、先入为主的意识概念不太适合捕捉情况在影响意识和后续行为中所扮演的角色。这是因为静态意识概念通常是在个人实际执行与安全相关的行为之前形成的，因此不能反映个人在执行这些行为时所遵循的过程的特定情况方面。例如，用户通常可能意识到网络钓鱼的安全威胁，但由于缺乏针对特定情况的威胁意识，仍然可能会点击未知的链接或附件（Alsharnouby, Alaca, & Chiasson, 2015；Dhamija, Tygar, & Hearst, 2006；Moody, Galletta, & Dunn, 2017）

Accordingly, the assumption of the aware user is challenged by studies on the behavioural aspects of phishing, which try to ascertain why phishing works, and how it can be detected and prevented. Questions about why phish ing works are fundamentally questions about awareness: when individuals fall for a phishing email, did they deliber ately assess the situation (eg, check URL in the link) or did they click on it without much deliberate thought (Dennis & Minas, 2018)? To answer this question, studies have mainly investigated the impact of email recipients individual characteristics (eg, demographics, personality traits, experience, knowledge), and the characteristics of the email (eg, sender address, gain or loss-framed messages) itself. Appendix B summarizes the results of previous research in greater detail. However, we posit that this question cannot be fully answered by assessing awareness through general knowledge and experience constructs (Algarni, Xu, & Chan, 2017; Moody et al., 2017), through pro ficiency tests (Wright & Marett, 2010), or asking participants about their attention towards security-related cues after the experiment (Vishwanath, Herath, Chen, Wang, & Rao, 2011; Wang, Herath, Chen, Vishwanath, & Rao, 2012). How people respond to queries is only an indirect reflection of their phenomenological awareness, becaus they are removed from the situation. In a similar vein, some experimental studies reminded their participants that they were about to judge phishing emails (Pattinson, Jerram, Parsons, McCormac, & Butavicius, 2012; Wang et al. 2017). Yet, priming participants into a phishing situation may be too removed from reality to be ecologically valid (D. Straub & Gefen, 2004), because it artificially raises their awareness.

因此，对网络钓鱼行为方面的研究对有意识的用户的假设提出了挑战，这些研究试图确定网络钓鱼为何有效，以及如何检测和预防网络钓鱼。关于网络钓鱼为何有效的问题从根本上来说是关于意识的问题：当个人陷入网络钓鱼电子邮件时，他们是否故意评估情况（例如，检查链接中的 URL），还是没有经过深思熟虑就点击了它（Dennis & Minas，2018）？为了回答这个问题，研究主要调查了电子邮件收件人个人特征（例如人口统计、个性特征、经验、知识）以及电子邮件本身特征（例如发件人地址、得失信息）的影响。附录 B 更详细地总结了先前的研究结果。然而，我们认为，通过一般知识和经验结构（Algarni, Xu, & Chan, 2017; Moody et al., 2017）、通过能力测试（Wright & Marett, 2010）评估意识，或在实验后询问参与者对安全相关线索的注意力（Vishwanath, Herath, Chen, Wang, & Rao, 2011; Wang, Herath, Chen,维什瓦纳特和拉奥，2012）。人们如何回应询问只是他们现象学意识的间接反映，因为他们脱离了情境。同样，一些实验研究提醒参与者他们即将判断网络钓鱼电子邮件（Pattinson、Jerram、Parsons、McCormac 和 Butavicius，2012 年；Wang 等人，2017 年）。然而，让参与者陷入网络钓鱼的情况可能过于脱离现实，在生态上不有效（D. Straub & Gefen，2004），因为它人为地提高了他们的意识。

As a departure from prior studies that focus on static aspects of awareness as a product detached from th actual situation, we take an approach that proposes that security-related behaviours result from an interactio between the person and the perception of the situation. Thus, our basic premise is that security-related behaviours are grounded within the context of the environment in which they occur and requires assessing the encountered situation. To conceptualize individual's actual awareness in a security-related situation in, we introduce the construct of situational information security awareness. It is derived from the perceptual cycle model (PCM) of situation aware ness (Smith, Hancock, & Peter, 1995), which considers both the product (ie, state of knowledge) and process (how that knowledge is created through interaction with the environment) of situation awareness. Our research aims to answer the following two research questions:

先前的研究侧重于意识的静态方面作为脱离实际情况的产品，与此不同的是，我们采取的方法提出，与安全相关的行为是人与情境感知之间相互作用的结果。因此，我们的基本前提是，与安全相关的行为是基于它们发生的环境背景，并且需要评估所遇到的情况。为了概念化个人在安全相关情境中的实际意识，我们引入了情境信息安全意识的构造。它源自情境意识的感知循环模型（PCM）（Smith，Hancock，＆Peter，1995），该模型考虑了情境意识的产品（即知识状态）和过程（如何通过与环境的交互来创建知识）。我们的研究旨在回答以下两个研究问题：

RQ1. What determines users' situational information security awareness?

RQ1。什么决定了用户的情境信息安全意识？

## RQ2. How does users' situational information security awareness influence security-related behaviour?

## RQ2。用户情境信息安全意识如何影响安全相关行为？

To address the research questions, we develop and empirically test a model of situational information security awareness by drawing on prior research on situation awareness, phishing literature, and protection motivation theory (PMT). Specifically, our model integrates key factors that draw on the interaction between the individual and his or her system environment in achieving awareness. This includes factors at the individual level (e.g., innate traits, expe rience) and system-level (e.g., email design, warning signal). Furthermore, once an event or situation is noted, prio coping and protection motivation literature argue that individuals evaluate how threatening the situation is and the resources at their disposal to cope with it (Lazarus & Folkman, 1984; Rogers, 1983). Situational information security awareness, which provides the contextual knowledge basis of the situation required for the appraisal process, is thus instrumental in explaining how users actually cope with a threatening situation. We carried out a multi-method phishing experiment including the use of eye tracking and a post-experimental survey with 107 employees. Our results suggest that phishing experience and the receipt of a security warning increase situational information security awareness, while phishing emails' contextual relevance and misplaced salience decrease it. Situational informa tion security awareness, in turn, increases perceived threat and perceived coping efficacy, fear, protection motivation and ultimately security-related behaviours.

为了解决研究问题，我们利用态势感知、网络钓鱼文献和保护动机理论 (PMT) 的先前研究，开发并实证测试了态势信息安全意识模型。具体来说，我们的模型整合了利用个人与其系统环境之间的交互来实现意识的关键因素。这包括个人层面的因素（例如，先天特质、经验）和系统层面的因素（例如，电子邮件设计、警告信号）。此外，一旦注意到某个事件或情况，优先应对和保护动机文献认为，个人会评估该情况的威胁程度以及可用于应对该情况的资源（Lazarus＆Folkman，1984；Rogers，1983）。情境信息安全意识为评估过程提供了情境知识基础，有助于解释用户如何实际应对威胁情境。我们对 107 名员工进行了多方法网络钓鱼实验，包括使用眼球追踪和实验后调查。我们的结果表明，网络钓鱼经历和收到安全警告会提高情境信息安全意识，而网络钓鱼电子邮件的上下文相关性和错误的显着性会降低这种意识。反过来，态势信息安全意识会增加感知到的威胁和感知到的应对效能、恐惧、保护动机以及最终的安全相关行为。

The richness of experimental (eye tracking and screen recording) and survey data collected enabled us to capture the process of how users collect security-related information cues of phishing and their responses to phishing emails which we could not have done by using a survey only. Shedding light on which security-related information cues users view or do not view and how this influences threat and coping appraisals and, ultimately, behaviour responds to calls from information security researchers demanding further insights into the complex interaction between infor mation processing and decision making by using cognitive neuroscience and its associated neurophysiological mea sures, such as eye tracking, applied to information security issues (Anderson, Vance, Kirwan, Eargle, & Jenkins, 2016) Our study also contributes to practice. If users fail to recognize a threat and consequently do not appraise it as bein one, their own and their organization's information security posture is weakened. Accordingly, this study also point to useful training and design recommendations to increase users' situational information security awareness.

丰富的实验（眼动追踪和屏幕记录）和调查数据收集使我们能够捕捉到用户如何收集网络钓鱼的安全相关信息线索以及他们对网络钓鱼电子邮件的响应的过程，这是我们仅通过调查无法做到的。揭示用户查看或不查看哪些与安全相关的信息线索，以及这些线索如何影响威胁和应对评估，以及最终的行为响应信息安全研究人员的呼吁，要求通过使用认知神经科学及其相关的神经生理学措施（例如应用于信息安全问题的眼动追踪）进一步深入了解信息处理和决策之间的复杂相互作用（Anderson、Vance、Kirwan、Eargle 和 Jenkins，2016）我们的研究也有助于实践。如果用户未能识别威胁并因此不将其视为威胁，那么他们自己和组织的信息安全态势就会受到削弱。因此，本研究还提出了有用的培训和设计建议，以提高用户的情境信息安全意识。

The paper proceeds as follows. First, we provide the theoretical background for situational information securit awareness and its key antecedents and consequences. We then develop the hypotheses of our research model. The subsequent sections present the research methodology, data analysis and results. Finally, we discuss the theoretica contributions and practical implications of our study, and conclude by addressing limitations and offering recommen dations for future research.

本文的进展如下。首先，我们提供态势信息安全意识的理论背景及其主要前因和后果。然后我们提出研究模型的假设。随后的部分介绍了研究方法、数据分析和结果。最后，我们讨论了我们研究的理论贡献和实际意义，并通过解决局限性并为未来的研究提供建议来结束。

## 2 | THEORETICAL BACKGROUND

## 2 |理论背景

## 2.1 | Situational information security awareness

## 2.1 |情境信息安全意识

We derive and define situational information security awareness based on research into awareness rooted in humar factors (Adams, Tenney, & Pew, 1995; Smith et al., 1995). In this research stream, scholars examine what they cal situation awareness, which describes the level of awareness that an individual has of a situation (Salmon et al., 2008). Prior research refers to situation awareness (Salmon et al., 2008) either as the product of awareness (ie knowledge that one can make use of; Endsley, 1995) or the process of gaining awareness (ie, how that knowledge i created through interaction with the environment; Fracker, 1991), or as a combination of the two (Adams et al., 1995; Smith et al., 1995). Although there is no universal definition of situation awareness (Salmon et al., 2008), it ha been argued that the construct demands an understanding of both the product and the process (Salmon et al., 2008 Stanton, Chambers, & Piggott, 2001)

我们基于对植根于人为因素的意识的研究，推导并定义了情境信息安全意识（Adams、Tenney 和 Pew，1995 年；Smith 等人，1995 年）。在这个研究流中，学者们研究了他们所说的情境意识，它描述了个人对情境的意识水平（Salmon et al., 2008）。先前的研究将情境意识（Salmon et al., 2008）视为意识的产物（即人们可以利用的知识；Endsley, 1995）或获得意识的过程（即我如何通过与环境的相互作用创造知识；Fracker, 1991），或者作为两者的组合（Adams et al., 1995；Smith et al., 1995）。尽管态势感知没有通用的定义（Salmon et al., 2008），但有人认为该结构需要对产品和流程的理解（Salmon et al., 2008 Stanton, Chambers, & Piggott, 2001）

In this regard, perceptual cycle models (PCM) of situation awareness (Adams et al., 1995; Smith et al., 1995) seem to offer the most comprehensive description of how awareness is achieved and maintained. These models have solid underpinning theory based on Neisser's (1976) original PCM and are comprehensive in that they refer to the continuous cycle of awareness acquisition and maintenance, encompassing both the product and the process of awareness (Salmon et al., 2008). According to Neisser (1976), knowledge in the form of schemata leads to the antici pation of certain information that directs exploratory movements and increases an individual's receptivity to particu lar aspects of the available information. As the schema absorbs information that an individual picks up from th environment, it serves in turn to modify the information that the schema is prepared to receive next further guiding exploration. Thus, the perceptual cycle combines both product and process aspects of awareness: ‘as product, it is the state of the active schema—the conceptual frame or context that governs the selection and interpretation of events. As process, it is the state of the perceptual cycle at any given moment. As process and product, it is the cycli cal resetting of each by the other’ (Adams et al. (1995, p. 89).

在这方面，情境意识的知觉循环模型（PCM）（Adams 等，1995；Smith 等，1995）似乎提供了如何实现和维持意识的最全面的描述。这些模型具有基于 Neisser (1976) 原始 PCM 的坚实基础理论，并且是全面的，因为它们涉及意识获取和维护的连续循环，涵盖意识的产品和过程（Salmon 等人，2008）。根据 Neisser (1976) 的观点，图式形式的知识会导致对某些信息的预期，从而指导探索性运动并增加个人对可用信息的特定方面的接受度。当图式吸收个人从环境中获取的信息时，它反过来会修改图式准备接收下一次进一步指导探索的信息。因此，感知循环结合了意识的产品和过程方面：“作为产品，它是活动图式的状态——控制事件选择和解释的概念框架或上下文。”作为过程，它是任何给定时刻的感知循环的状态。作为过程和产品，它是彼此之间的循环重置”（Adams et al. (1995, p. 89)。

Transferred to information security, when users enter the system environment to do a particular task, such a read an email, their initial awareness level (ie, the state of active schema) directs what they look for, such as onl reading the message or also attending to security-related information cues (eg, sender address, URL link). The infor mation users collect from the system environment is interpreted in consideration of their existing knowledge to hel them determine what is happening and also to help them to anticipate future states in which they might find them selves, for instance, if they click on a link or attachment. These anticipations further refine their perceptual sensitiv ity, as when the expectation of seeing one security-related information cue sensitizes a user to subtle variations o other cues in the email. Thus, users demonstrate their situational information security awareness by attending to more security-related information cues (eg, sender address, URL link), because their state informs them about th legitimacy of an email and thus also about future phishing risks

转移到信息安全，当用户进入系统环境执行特定任务（例如阅读电子邮件）时，他们的初始意识级别（即活动模式的状态）指示他们寻找的内容，例如仅阅读消息或还关注与安全相关的信息提示（例如，发件人地址、URL 链接）。用户从系统环境收集的信息会根据他们现有的知识进行解释，以帮助他们确定正在发生的事情，并帮助他们预测他们可能会发现自己的未来状态，例如，如果他们单击链接或附件。这些预期进一步提高了他们的感知敏感性，就像当看到一个与安全相关的信息提示的预期使用户对电子邮件中其他提示的微妙变化敏感时。因此，用户通过关注更多与安全相关的信息线索（例如发件人地址、URL 链接）来展示他们的情境信息安全意识，因为他们的状态告知他们电子邮件的合法性，从而也告知他们未来的网络钓鱼风险

Thus, we define situational information security awareness as a user's knowledge of particular security threat transported by security-related information cues captured in a situational process in the immediate system environ ment (Adams et al., 1995; Smith et al., 1995). We will describe the way we measured situational information securit awareness by using eye tracking within the research method section

因此，我们将情境信息安全意识定义为用户对特定安全威胁的了解，这些威胁是通过在直接系统环境中的情境过程中捕获的安全相关信息线索传递的（Adams 等，1995；Smith 等，1995）。我们将在研究方法部分描述我们如何使用眼动追踪来测量情境信息安全意识

## 2.2 | Antecedents of situational information security awareness

## 2.2 |情境信息安全意识的前因

PCM emphasizes the interaction between the individual and his or her environment in achieving and maintaining sit uation awareness and integrates top-down and bottom-up information processing. The former being schema-driven processing, in which an individual's schema directs perceptual exploration of available environmental information and the latter being environmentally-driven processing, in which certain environmental cues trigger perceptual explo ration. Accordingly, several factors related to both the individual as well as the system environment that influenc the key mechanisms of PCM have been identified in previous research approaches (Adams et al., 1995; Endsley 1995; Smith et al., 1995). These approaches share many commonalities that indicate key mechanisms that are also important for situational information security awareness.

PCM强调个体与环境之间的相互作用以实现和维持态势感知，并整合自上而下和自下而上的信息处理。前者是图式驱动的处理，其中个体的图式指导对可用环境信息的感知探索，后者是环境驱动的处理，其中某些环境线索触发感知探索。因此，在先前的研究方法中已经确定了与影响 PCM 关键机制的个体和系统环境相关的几个因素（Adams 等，1995；Endsley 1995；Smith 等，1995）。这些方法有许多共同点，这些共同点表明对于态势信息安全意识也很重要的关键机制。

Individuals differ in their ability to achieve situation awareness, given the same information input from the envi ronment. Experience as well as innate traits and abilities are hypothesized to influence an individual's informationprocessing mechanisms in the development of awareness (Endsley, 1995). Because schemas are developed over time with experience, more experienced individuals are better at pattern matching, that is, matching the patterns of a cur rent situation with a schema, to achieve situation awareness (Endsley & Jones, 2012). In addition, a person's predis position to be more trusting in general than others has been shown to lead to lower situation awareness, as they also tend to place too much trust in the displayed information in a system and are less capable of detecting system failures when they occur (Aydogan, Sharpanskykh, & Lo, 2015; Parasuraman, Sheridan, & Wickens, 2008). In ou study, we consider experience as past encounters with phishing emails and websites as well as the personality trai of agreeableness due to the more trusting nature of agreeable individuals

鉴于来自环境的相同信息输入，个人实现态势感知的能力有所不同。经验以及先天特征和能力被假设会影响个人在意识发展中的信息处理机制（Endsley，1995）。由于图式是随着时间的推移和经验而形成的，因此经验越丰富的人更擅长模式匹配，即将当前情况的模式与图式进行匹配，以实现态势感知（Endsley & Jones，2012）。此外，一个人比其他人更容易信任的倾向已被证明会导致较低的态势感知，因为他们也往往过于信任系统中显示的信息，并且在系统故障发生时检测到系统故障的能力较差（Aydogan、Sharpanskykh 和 Lo，2015 年；Parasuraman、Sheridan 和 Wickens，2008 年）。在我们的研究中，我们将经验视为过去与网络钓鱼电子邮件和网站的遭遇，以及由于宜人的个人更容易信任而产生的宜人的性格特征

The degree to which any individual can achieve situation awareness is greatly affected by the environment and by the design of the system they use (Endsley, 1995). Since situation awareness depends on the information that i available to the individual in the environment according to PCM, contextual relevance of information, which characterizes the pertinence of information to the particular situation, task or problem at hand (Wilson, 1973), is fundamen tal. Accordingly, system capabilities and interface design need to manage and present critical information in a meaningful and easy to process format (Endsley, 1995). Since phishing attackers can take advantage of which infor mation they want to display to the individual in their email message, our study considers contextual relevance of mail as the pertinence of the email message premise to the recipient, such as the alignment to his or her work contex (Hong, 2012; Steves, Greene, & Theofanos, 2019).

任何个人获得态势感知的程度很大程度上受到环境和他们使用的系统设计的影响（Endsley，1995）。由于根据 PCM，态势感知取决于个人在环境中可获得的信息，因此信息的上下文相关性（表征信息与当前的特定情况、任务或问题的相关性）是基础（Wilson，1973）。因此，系统功能和界面设计需要以有意义且易于处理的格式管理和呈现关键信息（Endsley，1995）。由于网络钓鱼攻击者可以利用他们想要在电子邮件中向个人显示的信息，因此我们的研究将邮件的上下文相关性视为电子邮件前提与收件人的相关性，例如与其工作环境的一致性（Hong，2012；Steves、Greene 和 Theofanos，2019）。

Although individuals will generally attempt seek out information relevant to their goals (top-down informatio processing), their attention will be caught by information that is highly salient and trigger bottom-up processing. In many systems, there is a proliferation of signals drawing individual's attention, often either misleading or overwhelm ing them. Misplaced salience refers to the overuse of prominent visual features that overwhelm and misdirect individ uals' attention, thereby negatively influencing situation awareness (Endsley & Jones, 2012). For example, th overuse of colours, buttons, company logos or pictures of a person can be used by phishing attackers to distract the individual from more important information that may reveal the email's true nature.

尽管个人通常会尝试寻找与其目标相关的信息（自上而下的信息处理），但他们的注意力会被高度显着的信息所吸引并触发自下而上的处理。在许多系统中，存在大量吸引个人注意力的信号，这些信号通常会误导或压倒他们。错位显着性是指过度使用突出的视觉特征，压倒和误导个人的注意力，从而对态势感知产生负面影响（Endsley＆Jones，2012）。例如，网络钓鱼攻击者可能会过度使用颜色、按钮、公司徽标或人物图片来分散个人的注意力，使他们无法关注可能揭示电子邮件真实性质的更重要信息。

The critical cues used for activating an individual's mental models and schemata could be also made salient by a security warning as a trigger (Endsley & Jones, 2012). Security warnings are designed to call users' attentio to important information that they may be unaware of because they are distracted, or they lack vigilance Whereas designers' philosophy behind security warnings is that this is the only information that users need to decide what to do, in reality the warning is just one information cue that is processed in addition to all othe information available in the situation. Thus, users often search for confirming evidence to determine whether the warning indicates a real problem before responding to it (Endsley & Jones, 2012). In our study, we consider a security warning as discrete communication that is designed to persuade individuals to improve their information security posture (Anderson et al., 2016). Specifically, a red pop-up identifying a website as malicious, describing the threats related to the site and offering different coping mechanisms (exit the website, retrieving more infor mation or ignore the warning).

用于激活个人心理模型和图式的关键线索也可以通过安全警告作为触发器来突出（Endsley & Jones，2012）。安全警告旨在唤起用户对重要信息的注意力，而这些信息可能是用户因为分心或缺乏警惕而没有意识到的。安全警告背后的设计者理念是，这是用户决定做什么所需的唯一信息，但实际上，警告只是除了该情况下所有其他可用信息之外还要处理的一种信息提示。因此，用户在做出响应之前经常会寻找确认证据来确定警告是否表明存在真正的问题（Endsley & Jones，2012）。在我们的研究中，我们将安全警告视为离散通信，旨在说服个人改善其信息安全状况（Anderson 等人，2016）。具体来说，一个红色弹出窗口将网站标识为恶意网站，描述与该网站相关的威胁并提供不同的应对机制（退出网站、检索更多信息或忽略警告）。

## 2.3 | Consequences of situational information security awareness

## 2.3 |情境信息安全意识的后果

To study the particular consequences of situational information security awareness, we draw on protection motiva tion theory (PMT, Rogers, 1975, 1983). PMT describes a process that starts with the receipt of information (sources of information), which leads to an assessment of the information by the recipient of the information (cognitive medi ating process), and ultimately to the use of this information to take action (coping mode). The use of situational infor mation security awareness as sources of information is reasonable because it describes a generative process of knowledge creation and informed action taking, specifically how individuals acquire contextual knowledge which is directly derived, in part, from the perceptual information presented to individuals in their immediate situation (Smith et al., 1995). As per coping theory upon which PMT was, in part, originally based, such processes inform the development of the cognitive appraisals. For example, the clear distinction between contextual knowledge and appraisal, and the dependence of appraisal upon knowledge, is emphasized in Lazarus and Smith (1988).

为了研究情境信息安全意识的特殊后果，我们利用保护动机理论（PMT，Rogers，1975，1983）。 PMT描述了一个从接收信息（信息来源）开始，导致信息接收者对信息进行评估（认知中介过程），并最终利用这些信息采取行动（应对模式）的过程。使用情境信息安全意识作为信息来源是合理的，因为它描述了知识创造和明智行动采取的生成过程，特别是个人如何获取情境知识，而情境知识部分直接来自于个人在当前情境中呈现的感知信息（Smith 等，1995）。根据 PMT 最初部分所依据的应对理论，这些过程为认知评估的发展提供了信息。例如，Lazarus 和 Smith (1988) 强调了情境知识和评价之间的明确区别，以及评价对知识的依赖。

What information is gathered in the situation produces specific effects on decision making, but how this process unfolds depends on the way the individual evaluates and interprets the different elements of the situation, namel the threat element and the coping response as conveyed by security-related cues. This interpretative process results in threat and coping appraisals. In this sense, situation awareness can be used to derive both the threat component and the coping response provided by a situation. PMT, on the other hand, is particularly effective in describing the underlying mechanisms through which the security-related cues in a situation produce their effects. Taken together we believe that situation awareness can help answering what questions, whereas PMT can provide further answers to how questions. This distinction between contextual knowledge and appraisal enables seamless theoretical integra tion. Thus, in our study, we integrate situational information security awareness as a key information source influenc ing threat and coping appraisals in a security-related context. The appropriateness of integrating situation awarenes and PMT is further elaborated in Appendix C.

在这种情况下收集到的信息会对决策产生特定的影响，但这个过程如何展开取决于个人评估和解释情况不同要素的方式，即威胁要素和安全相关线索所传达的应对反应。这个解释过程导致威胁和应对评估。从这个意义上说，态势感知可用于得出威胁成分和情况提供的应对响应。另一方面，PMT 在描述某种情况下的安全相关线索产生影响的基本机制方面特别有效。综上所述，我们认为态势感知可以帮助回答“什么”问题，而 PMT 可以进一步回答“如何”问题。情境知识和评价之间的这种区别使得理论的无缝整合成为可能。因此，在我们的研究中，我们将态势信息安全意识作为影响安全相关环境中威胁和应对评估的关键信息源。附录 C 进一步阐述了整合态势感知和 PMT 的适当性。

During threat appraisal, individuals form beliefs regarding the degree of threat existing in a situation. They gen erate a subjective evaluation of the threat in that situation, which is perceived threat. Perceived threat has two dimensions, namely perceived threat severity (ie, individuals' beliefs about the seriousness of the threat's conse quences) and perceived threat vulnerability (ie, individuals' beliefs about the likelihood that they will experience the threat). Together, perceived threat severity and perceived threat vulnerability determine the magnitude of perceive threat (Wang et al., 2017). Thus, it is theoretically reasonable to consider perceived threat as a formative second order construct comprising both perceived threat severity and perceived threat vulnerability (Wang et al., 2017) Once a threat is perceived, fear, a negatively valenced emotion occurs (Floyd, Prentice-Dunn, & Rogers, 2000). Dur ing coping appraisal, individuals form beliefs regarding their ability to control the threats. The appraisal allows generation of a subjective evaluation of coping capability in the situation, that is perceived coping efficacy. Perceived coping efficacy has two dimensions as well, namely perceived response efficacy (ie, individuals' beliefs that the recommended behaviour will effectively reduce the threat) and perceived self-efficacy (individuals' beliefs in their ability to successfully perform the recommended behaviour). We also include both components to give a more holistic pic ture of perceived coping efficacy and consider perceived coping efficacy as a formative second-order construct according to the literature (Floyd et al., 2000; Popova, 2012; Witte & Allen, 2000). Perceived threat, fear and perceived coping efficacy increase protection motivation, that is, individuals' intention to protect themselves from a potential threat. Protection motivation, in turn, results in protective behaviours (Witte & Allen, 2000).

在威胁评估过程中，个人会对某种情况下存在的威胁程度形成信念。他们对这种情况下的威胁进行主观评估，即感知威胁。感知威胁有两个维度，即感知威胁严重性（即个人对威胁后果严重性的信念）和感知威胁脆弱性（即个人对他们将经历威胁的可能性的信念）。感知威胁严重性和感知威胁脆弱性共同决定了感知威胁的程度（Wang et al., 2017）。因此，理论上合理的是，将感知威胁视为一个形成性的二阶结构，包括感知威胁严重性和感知威胁脆弱性（Wang et al., 2017）。一旦感知到威胁，就会产生恐惧、负价情绪（Floyd, Prentice-Dunn, & Rogers, 2000）。在应对评估过程中，个人会对自己控制威胁的能力形成信念。该评估允许生成对该情况下的应对能力的主观评价，即感知的应对效能。感知应对效能也有两个维度，即感知反应效能（即个人相信推荐的行为将有效减少威胁）和感知自我效能（个人相信自己有能力成功执行推荐行为）。我们还包括这两个组成部分，以更全面地描述感知应对效能，并根据文献将感知应对效能视为形成性二阶结构（Floyd et al., 2000; Popova, 2012; Witte & Allen, 2000）。感知到的威胁、恐惧和感知到的应对效能会增加保护动机，即个体保护自己免受潜在威胁的意图。保护动机反过来会导致保护行为（Witte & Allen，2000）。

## 3 | HYPOTHESES DEVELOPMENT

## 3 |假设发展

Drawing on situation awareness research and PMT, we developed a research model to outline how situational information security awareness is affected by individual- and system-level factors, as well as how situational information security awareness influences subsequent threat and coping appraisals. Our theoretical model is shown in Figure 1 For theoretical cohesiveness, we also evaluated the consequent relationships between constructs of the PMT nomology, including fear, protection motivation and actual security-related behaviours (Boss, Galletta, Lowry, Moody, & Polak, 2015).

借鉴态势感知研究和PMT，我们开发了一个研究模型来概述态势信息安全意识如何受到个体和系统层面因素的影响，以及态势信息安全意识如何影响后续的威胁和应对评估。我们的理论模型如图 1 所示。为了理论的凝聚力，我们还评估了 PMT 法则的构造之间的后续关系，包括恐惧、保护动机和实际的安全相关行为（Boss、Galletta、Lowry、Moody 和 Polak，2015）。

## 3.1 | Antecedents of situational information security awareness

## 3.1 |情境信息安全意识的前因

Based on situation awareness literature, an individual's awareness is influenced by individual factors (eg, innate abili ties and experience) and system-related factors (eg, interface design and warning signals; Endsley, 1995; Salmon et al., 2008). Initially, we focus on characteristics of the individual, including relevant information-processing mechanisms and components that play a role in achieving situational information security awareness. In particular we propose that experience with phishing and the personality trait of agreeableness are important factors that influ ence situational information security awareness. Then, we focus on system-level attributes and propose that contex tualized relevance of and misplaced salience in a phishing email, as well as the receipt of a security warning influenc situational information security awareness.

根据情境意识文献，个人的意识受到个人因素（例如先天能力和经验）和系统相关因素（例如界面设计和警告信号；Endsley，1995；Salmon 等，2008）的影响。首先，我们关注个人的特征，包括相关的信息处理机制和在实现情境信息安全意识中发挥作用的组件。我们特别提出，网络钓鱼经历和宜人的性格特征是影响情境信息安全意识的重要因素。然后，我们关注系统级属性，并提出网络钓鱼电子邮件的上下文相关性和错位显着性以及安全警告的接收会影响态势信息安全意识。
